quarantined_verses.text: Nẹ otọ rhe Ọghẹnẹ vwọ ma odjuvwu vẹ akpọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ne oto rhe oghene vwo ma odjuvwu ve akpo

quarantined_verses.text: Akpọ na da de dia reghe reghe diodi, ebrin da enu rẹ akpọ na duvwu; Erhi rẹ Ọghẹnẹ kọye re yan vwẹ enu rẹ ame na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: akpo na da de dia reghe reghe diodi ebrin da enu re akpo na duvwu erhi re oghene koye re yan vwe enu re ame na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ da ma irharheghe na o da hẹriẹ ame rọ obotọ rẹ irharheghe na vwo nẹ ame rọ obenu rẹ irharheghe na. O da ghene dia ọtiọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene da ma irharheghe na o da herie ame ro oboto re irharheghe na vwo ne ame ro obenu re irharheghe na o da ghene dia otioye

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn ame rẹ otọ rẹ odjuvwu na rhi koko oma vwẹ asan ọvo, rere e ji otọ ọyaya vwẹ oma phia. Ọ da ghene dia ọtiọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta gbe jen ame re oto re odjuvwu na rhi koko oma vwe asan ovo rere e ji oto oyaya vwe oma phia o da ghene dia otioye

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn orẹmrẹ phia vwẹ evun rẹ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu na rọ hẹriẹ uvo nẹ ason, re ayen dia kẹ oka kugbe ọke vẹ ẹdẹ te ukpe,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta gbe jen oremre phia vwe evun re irharheghe re odjuvwu na ro herie uvo ne ason re ayen dia ke oka kugbe oke ve ede te ukpe

quarantined_verses.text: gbe jẹn ayen dia orẹmrẹ vwẹ evun rẹ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu na rọ vwẹ orẹmrẹ kẹ akpọ na. O da ghene dia ọtiọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: gbe jen ayen dia oremre vwe evun re irharheghe re odjuvwu na ro vwe oremre ke akpo na o da ghene dia otioye

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ da ma irhukpẹ ride ive, urhukpẹ rode na kọye ri sun uvo, urhukpẹ re otete na kọye ri sun ason, ọ ke je ma isio rhe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene da ma irhukpe ride ive urhukpe rode na koye ri sun uvo urhukpe re otete na koye ri sun ason o ke je ma isio rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ de phi ayen phihọ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu na re ọ vwẹ orẹmrẹ kẹ akpọ na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene de phi ayen phiho irharheghe re odjuvwu na re o vwe oremre ke akpo na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn obo ri vwo arhọ ejobi vọn evun rẹ ame na, rere ephran rhan vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na vwẹ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta gbe jen obo ri vwo arho ejobi von evun re ame na rere ephran rhan vwe enu re akpo na vwe irharheghe re odjuvwu

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ ayen tanẹ, We vwiẹ ri we bun phihọ re wa vọn ame rẹ urhie na, rere ephran rhe bun phihọ vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene da ne erhovwo ke ayen tane we vwie ri we bun phiho re wa von ame re urhie na rere ephran rhe bun phiho vwe enu re akpo na

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn avwanre ma ohwo vwẹ oma rẹ avwanre, rọ họhọ avwanre, re ayen vwo ogangan vwẹ enu rẹ erin rẹ urhie, vwẹ enu rẹ ephran ri obenu, vwẹ enu rẹ uchuru, kugbe vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na vẹ obo ri kpono vwẹ enu rẹ otọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene da ta gbe jen avwanre ma ohwo vwe oma re avwanre ro hoho avwanre re ayen vwo ogangan vwe enu re erin re urhie vwe enu re ephran ri obenu vwe enu re uchuru kugbe vwe enu re akpo na ve obo ri kpono vwe enu re oto na

quarantined_verses.text: Kọye Ọghẹnẹ da ma ohwo vwẹ oma rọye, oma rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ọye ọ vwọ ma ayen, ọshare vẹ aye ọ ma ayen.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: koye oghene da ma ohwo vwe oma roye oma re oghene oye o vwo ma ayen oshare ve aye o ma ayen

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ ayen, We vwiẹ ri we bun phihọ, re wa vọn akpọ na, ru we phio kparobọ, kugbe re we vwo ogangan vwẹ enu rẹ erin rẹ urhie, ephran ri obenu kugbe enu ri kemu kemu rọ yan vwe otọ na ejobi.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene da ta ke ayen we vwie ri we bun phiho re wa von akpo na ru we phio kparobo kugbe re we vwo ogangan vwe enu re erin re urhie ephran ri obenu kugbe enu ri kemu kemu ro yan vwe oto na ejobi

quarantined_verses.text: Eranvwe keranvwe rọ otọ na, ọphran kọphran rọ obenu, emu kemu ri kpono vwẹ enu rẹ otọ na, emu kemu ro vwo ẹnwẹn vwẹ otọ na, Me vwẹ ẹbe ọkpokpọ na re dia emuọre ke ayen. Ọ da ghene dia ọtiọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: eranvwe keranvwe ro oto na ophran kophran ro obenu emu kemu ri kpono vwe enu re oto na emu kemu ro vwo enwen vwe oto na me vwe ebe okpokpo na re dia emuore ke ayen o da ghene dia otioye

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ ighwrẹ iruo rẹ emama rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ruru ejobi de rhi re, o de rovwoma vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ ighwrẹ na vwẹ enu rẹ iruo ro ruru.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe ede re ighwre iruo re emama re oghene ruru ejobi de rhi re o de rovwoma vwe ede re ighwre na vwe enu re iruo ro ruru

quarantined_verses.text: Ọtiọye Ọghẹnẹ de bruphihọ ẹdẹ rẹ ighwrẹ na, ọ da vwẹ ọghọ kẹ, fikiridie ẹdẹ yena Ọghẹnẹ vwo rovwoma vwẹ enu rẹ iruo ro ruru vwẹ emama rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: otioye oghene de bruphiho ede re ighwre na o da vwe ogho ke fikiridie ede yena oghene vwo rovwoma vwe enu re iruo ro ruru vwe emama roye

quarantined_verses.text: Enana keye uvwiẹ rẹ odjuvwu vẹ akpọ vwẹ ọke ra vwọ ma ayen. Vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ vwọ ma akpọ vẹ odjuvwu nu,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: enana keye uvwie re odjuvwu ve akpo vwe oke ra vwo ma ayen vwe ede re orovwohwo oghene vwo ma akpo ve odjuvwu nu

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ ọke rẹ okankọn vuọvo je djẹ vwẹ aghwa na eyẹ odi vuọvo je djẹ phiaa - kidie Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ je rhọ osio phihọ akpọ na-a, yẹ ohwo je dia ro voro otọ na-a;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe oke re okankon vuovo je dje vwe aghwa na eye odi vuovo je dje phiaa kidie orovwohwo oghene je rho osio phiho akpo na a ye ohwo je dia ro voro oto na a

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ de voro udju phihọ Idẹn vwẹ ẹbẹre rẹ ọnre da vacha, kẹ Etiyin o phi ohwo rọ mare na phihọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo oghene de voro udju phiho iden vwe ebere re onre da vacha ke etiyin o phi ohwo ro mare na phiho

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ evun rẹ otọ na kọye Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ tare nẹ urhe kurhe ro yovwiri, fẹro ji fẹriọ gba djẹrhe, urhe rẹ arhọ na rọ ji uherevie rẹ udju na, kugbe urhe rẹ erianriẹn rẹ erhuvwu vẹ umiovwo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe evun re oto na koye orovwohwo oghene tare ne urhe kurhe ro yovwiri fero ji ferio gba djerhe urhe re arho na ro ji uherevie re udju na kugbe urhe re erianrien re erhuvwu ve umiovwo

quarantined_verses.text: ẹkẹvuọvo urhe rẹ erianriẹn rẹ erhuvwu vẹ umiovwo na wọ riọọ, kidie ẹdẹ re wọ rerọ ku wo ghwu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo urhe re erianrien re erhuvwu ve umiovwo na wo rioo kidie ede re wo rero ku wo ghwu

quarantined_verses.text: Asakiephana ọrọdekọ kọye Me vwo aghwanre nọ eranvwe ri chekọ vwẹ aghwa rẹ Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ mare na. Ọ da ta kẹ aye na, Ọ dianẹ Ọghẹnẹ tare nẹ, Wọ re emamọ rẹ irhe rẹ udju na vuọvo-o?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: asakiephana orodeko koye me vwo aghwanre no eranvwe ri cheko vwe aghwa re orovwohwo oghene mare na o da ta ke aye na o diane oghene tare ne wo re emamo re irhe re udju na vuovo o

quarantined_verses.text: Aye na da ta kẹ ọrọdekọ na, Avwanre sa re emamọ rẹ irhe rẹ udju na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: aye na da ta ke orodeko na avwanre sa re emamo re irhe re udju na

quarantined_verses.text: ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ tare nẹ, Wa ria emamọ rẹ urhe rọ uherevie rẹ udju na-a, eyẹ wa vwẹ obọ te-e, we de rhe ghwu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oghene tare ne wa ria emamo re urhe ro uherevie re udju na a eye wa vwe obo te e we de rhe ghwu

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen de nyo urhuru rẹ Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ rọ yan vwẹ udju na vwẹ ọke rẹ ovwọnvwọn, te ọshare na te aye na de si oma nu kẹ Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ vwẹ uvwre rẹ irhe rẹ udju na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen de nyo urhuru re orovwohwo oghene ro yan vwe udju na vwe oke re ovwonvwon te oshare na te aye na de si oma nu ke orovwohwo oghene vwe uvwre re irhe re udju na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọshare na da ta, Aye ru wọ vwọ kẹ vwẹ nẹ o nene uvwe dia, ọye vwẹ emamọ rẹ urhe na kẹ vwẹ, Me da re.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oshare na da ta aye ru wo vwo ke vwe ne o nene uvwe dia oye vwe emamo re urhe na ke vwe me da re

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ ọke rhi vwo tere Ken da reyọ izobo rẹ emamọ rẹ otọ na vwo rhe Ọrovwohwo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re oke rhi vwo tere ken da reyo izobo re emamo re oto na vwo rhe orovwohwo

quarantined_verses.text: Ebẹl da je vwẹ izobo rẹ upene rẹ uchuru rọye rọ pha sọkọ sọkọ vwo rhe Ọrovwohwo. Ọrovwohwo de mu ọghọ kẹ izobo rẹ Ebẹl,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ebel da je vwe izobo re upene re uchuru roye ro pha soko soko vwo rhe orovwohwo orovwohwo de mu ogho ke izobo re ebel

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo da ta kẹ Ken, Die ivun vwo miovwo uwe, rẹ opharo wẹn vwọ dia tughẹ?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta ke ken die ivun vwo miovwo uwe re opharo wen vwo dia tughe

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo da ta, Die kọye wo ruru na? Urhuru rẹ ọbara rẹ oniọvo wẹn kperi nẹ otọ bru vwe rhe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta die koye wo ruru na urhuru re obara re oniovo wen kperi ne oto bru vwe rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ enẹna a harhe owẹ eka nẹ otọ na rhe, ọto rhie unu rọye vwọ da ọbara rẹ oniọvo wẹn mie we.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe enena a harhe owe eka ne oto na rhe oto rhie unu roye vwo da obara re oniovo wen mie we

quarantined_verses.text: Nighe wọ djẹ vwẹ nonẹ na vwo nẹ otọ na re, Me da mrẹ opharo wẹn ki mi sioma nẹ, ke Me dia ọvwisusu kugbe osoghoro vwẹ evun rẹ akpọ na, ohwo kohwo rọ mrẹ vwẹ ejobi ko hwe vwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: nighe wo dje vwe none na vwo ne oto na re me da mre opharo wen ki mi sioma ne ke me dia ovwisusu kugbe osoghoro vwe evun re akpo na ohwo kohwo ro mre vwe ejobi ko hwe vwe

quarantined_verses.text: Ken da yan nẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo, ọ da ra dia otọ ri Nọd, vwẹ obọrhe rẹ Idẹn
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ken da yan ne obaro re orovwohwo o da ra dia oto ri nod vwe oborhe re iden

quarantined_verses.text: Ọnana ọbe rẹ uvwiẹ rẹ Adam. Vwẹ ọke rẹ Ọghẹnẹ vwọ ma ohwo, ọ da ma vwẹ uhoho rẹ Ọghẹnẹ
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: onana obe re uvwie re adam vwe oke re oghene vwo ma ohwo o da ma vwe uhoho re oghene

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ re Adam vwẹ ọke ro vwo vwiẹ Sẹt nu da dia ikpe uri ẹne, o de ji vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ efa
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ede re akpo re adam vwe oke ro vwo vwie set nu da dia ikpe uri ene o de ji vwie emeshare kugbe emete efa

quarantined_verses.text: Ri Inọsh vwọ dia akpọ ikpe ujọne gbe ihwe re ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Kenan.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ri inosh vwo dia akpo ikpe ujone gbe ihwe re o da rhe dia ose ri kenan

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ Inọsh rhi vwo vwiẹ Kenan nu ọ da dia akpọ ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ ihwiori, o de rhe vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ efa.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re inosh rhi vwo vwie kenan nu o da dia akpo ikpe uri ene gbe ihwiori o de rhe vwie emeshare kugbe emete efa

quarantined_verses.text: Jared rhi vwo vwiẹ Inọk nu, ọ da dia akpọ na ikpe uri ẹne, o de rhi vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ efa.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jared rhi vwo vwie inok nu o da dia akpo na ikpe uri ene o de rhi vwie emeshare kugbe emete efa

quarantined_verses.text: o de se odẹ rọye Noa, tanẹ, Vwẹ evun rẹ otọ rẹ Ọrovwohwo harhere na ọye Ọnana che nurhe rhe kẹ avwanre omaerovwo nẹ iruo vẹ owian rẹ abọ rẹ avwanre.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o de se ode roye noa tane vwe evun re oto re orovwohwo harhere na oye onana che nurhe rhe ke avwanre omaerovwo ne iruo ve owian re abo re avwanre

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ihwo vwo buẹ phihọ vwẹ enu rẹ otọ na re, ayen rhi vwo vwiẹ emetẹ re,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ihwo vwo bue phiho vwe enu re oto na re ayen rhi vwo vwie emete re

quarantined_verses.text: emọ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ emetẹ rẹ ihwo nẹ iyovwiri gangan; ayen da reyọ uche ri je ayen vwọ rọvwọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: emo re oghene da mre emete re ihwo ne iyovwiri gangan ayen da reyo uche ri je ayen vwo rovwo

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo da mrẹ nẹ evun umwemwu rẹ ohwo rhoro gangan vwẹ evun rẹ akpọ na, ọ da je mrẹ nẹ iroro rẹ udu rọye pha brabra vwẹ ọke ejobi.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da mre ne evun umwemwu re ohwo rhoro gangan vwe evun re akpo na o da je mre ne iroro re udu roye pha brabra vwe oke ejobi

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da da Ọrovwohwo gangan rọ vwọ ma ohwo phihọ akpọ na, ọ da da vwẹ udu rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da da orovwohwo gangan ro vwo ma ohwo phiho akpo na o da da vwe udu roye

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo da ta, Mi phoro ohwo te eranwe te obo ri kpono vwẹ otọ na, rẹ ephra ri obenu na, kidie ọ da vwẹ gangan re Me vwọ ma ayen.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta mi phoro ohwo te eranwe te obo ri kpono vwe oto na re ephra ri obenu na kidie o da vwe gangan re me vwo ma ayen

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo Noa kọye ivun rọye vwerhe Ọrovwohwo na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo noa koye ivun roye vwerhe orovwohwo na

quarantined_verses.text: Kidie nighe, Me cha vwẹ ame ku akpọ na, re ọ rhe ghwọrọ uvwo ejobi ri vwo ẹnwẹn rẹ arhọ rẹ otọ rẹ odjuvwu na; kemu kemu ri enu rẹ akpọ na ejobi ko ghwu re.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: kidie nighe me cha vwe ame ku akpo na re o rhe ghworo uvwo ejobi ri vwo enwen re arho re oto re odjuvwu na kemu kemu ri enu re akpo na ejobi ko ghwu re

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen vi Noa da yan usu ro evun rẹ okọ na, ivivẹ rẹ ayen obo ri vwo ẹnwẹn rẹ arhọ ejobi.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen vi noa da yan usu ro evun re oko na ivive re ayen obo ri vwo enwen re arho ejobi

quarantined_verses.text: Ame na de reghe akpọ na ejobi yọn je vwọnvwọn cha; okọ na de phorhi vwẹ enu rẹ ame na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ame na de reghe akpo na ejobi yon je vwonvwon cha oko na de phorhi vwe enu re ame na

quarantined_verses.text: Kemu kemu ro vwo ẹnwẹn rọ yan vwẹ akpọ na ejobi de ghwure, ephra, uchuru, eranvwe rẹ aghwa, erọnvwọ ri biẹyi re rhẹrhẹ vwẹ ame na, kugbe kohwo kohwo,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: kemu kemu ro vwo enwen ro yan vwe akpo na ejobi de ghwure ephra uchuru eranvwe re aghwa eronvwo ri bieyi re rherhe vwe ame na kugbe kohwo kohwo

quarantined_verses.text: ogbugbu rẹ ame na da tangbe, evakpo rẹ obo odjuvwu na ejobi de rhurhu, osio rọ rhọ nẹ enu cha da daji,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ogbugbu re ame na da tangbe evakpo re obo odjuvwu na ejobi de rhurhu osio ro rho ne enu cha da daji

quarantined_verses.text: vwẹ emeranvwe rẹ ighwrẹ, vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ ihwe gbẹ ighwrẹ rẹ emeranvwe na, okọ na da rhe kpọ muotọ vwẹ enu rẹ ugbenu ri Ararat.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe emeranvwe re ighwre vwe ede re ihwe gbe ighwre re emeranvwe na oko na da rhe kpo muoto vwe enu re ugbenu ri ararat

quarantined_verses.text: ẹkẹvuọvo inekuku na mrẹ asan rọ rhan mu-u, ọ da rhoma rhan bro rhe vwẹ evun rẹ okọ na, kidie yẹ ame na ji phoro enu rẹ otọ na ejobi. Etiyin ọ da riẹn obọ rọye vwọ reyọ phihọ evun rẹ okọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo inekuku na mre asan ro rhan mu u o da rhoma rhan bro rhe vwe evun re oko na kidie ye ame na ji phoro enu re oto na ejobi etiyin o da rien obo roye vwo reyo phiho evun re oko na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da rha hẹrhẹ ẹdẹ ighwrẹ efa, ọ ke rhoma siobọ nẹ inekuku na nẹ evun rẹ okọ na;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da rha herhe ede ighwre efa o ke rhoma siobo ne inekuku na ne evun re oko na

quarantined_verses.text: inekuku na da rha bro rhe vwẹ ovwọnvwọn, e vwo no, o mu ọbe rẹ olive ọkpokpọ vwọ hwunu, Noa ke rhe riẹn nẹ ame na kpọ nẹ akpọ na re.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: inekuku na da rha bro rhe vwe ovwonvwon e vwo no o mu obe re olive okpokpo vwo hwunu noa ke rhe rien ne ame na kpo ne akpo na re

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ ke je rhoma hẹrhẹ ẹdẹ ighwrẹ efa, ọ da rhoma siobọ nẹ inekuku na, ọ gbe rhoma rhan bro rhe ọfa-a.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o ke je rhoma herhe ede ighwre efa o da rhoma siobo ne inekuku na o gbe rhoma rhan bro rhe ofa a

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ emeranvwe rivẹ, vwẹ ẹdẹ ujuvẹ gbẹ ighwrẹ rẹ emeranvwe na, otọ na da kpọre.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe emeranvwe rive vwe ede ujuve gbe ighwre re emeranvwe na oto na da kpore

quarantined_verses.text: Reyọ kemu kemu ejobi ro vwo arhọ re vẹ owẹ gba herọ vwẹ evun rẹ okọ na ejobi - ephra kugbe eranvwe kugbe emu kemu ri kpono vwẹ enu rẹ otọ na rere ayen mrẹ asan vwiẹ buebu vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na, re ayen mo re ayen bu phihọ vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: reyo kemu kemu ejobi ro vwo arho re ve owe gba hero vwe evun re oko na ejobi ephra kugbe eranvwe kugbe emu kemu ri kpono vwe enu re oto na rere ayen mre asan vwie buebu vwe enu re akpo na re ayen mo re ayen bu phiho vwe enu re akpo na

quarantined_verses.text: Kọye Noa da yan phia, ọ vẹ emọ rọye te aye rọye te eya rẹ emọ rọye
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: koye noa da yan phia o ve emo roye te aye roye te eya re emo roye

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ Ọrovwohwo vwo nyo ọnrhe ghwoghwo rẹ izobo na, Ọrovwohwo da ta vwẹ udu rọye, Me gbe harhe otọ na ọfa vwi fiki rẹ ohwo-o, kidie iroro rẹ evun rọye nẹ ọke-emọ rhe pha brabra, eyẹ Me gbe ghwọrọ emu kemu ro vwo arhọ re Me mare ọfa-a.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re orovwohwo vwo nyo onrhe ghwoghwo re izobo na orovwohwo da ta vwe udu roye me gbe harhe oto na ofa vwi fiki re ohwo o kidie iroro re evun roye ne oke emo rhe pha brabra eye me gbe ghworo emu kemu ro vwo arho re me mare ofa a

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ de bruphihọ kẹ Noa vẹ emọ rọye, ọ da ta kẹ ayen, We vwiẹ ri we bu phihọ, ru wa vọn akpọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene de bruphiho ke noa ve emo roye o da ta ke ayen we vwie ri we bu phiho ru wa von akpo na

quarantined_verses.text: Fiki rẹ ọbara rẹ arhọ wẹn na ke Me ghene nekpẹn rẹ osa rọye, vwẹ obọ rẹ eranvwe keranvwe Me da nekpẹn rọye Etiyin ji te ohwo rẹ akpọ, vwẹ obọ rẹ oniọvo rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: fiki re obara re arho wen na ke me ghene nekpen re osa roye vwe obo re eranvwe keranvwe me da nekpen roye etiyin ji te ohwo re akpo vwe obo re oniovo roye

quarantined_verses.text: Me cha vwẹ aphoro mẹ vwo mu vwẹ enu rẹ ikoro na, kọ cha dia oka rẹ ọphọ vwẹ uvwre mẹ kugbe akpọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: me cha vwe aphoro me vwo mu vwe enu re ikoro na ko cha dia oka re opho vwe uvwre me kugbe akpo na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ikoro de mu vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na re a da mrẹ aphoro vwẹ enu rẹ ikoro na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ikoro de mu vwe enu re akpo na re a da mre aphoro vwe enu re ikoro na

quarantined_verses.text: Emeshare ri Noa ri nẹ evun rẹ okọ na rhe da dia Shẹm, Ham, kugbe Jafẹt, Ham kọye ọsẹ ri Kenan.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: emeshare ri noa ri ne evun re oko na rhe da dia shem ham kugbe jafet ham koye ose ri kenan

quarantined_verses.text: Shẹm vẹ Jafẹt da reyọ ewun, ayen da vwọ kpahe igabọ, ayen da vwẹ ukuko re rhurhu ẹba rẹ ọsẹ rayen ayen de ku opharo fia, ayen gbe rha mrẹ ẹba rẹ ọsẹ raye-en.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: shem ve jafet da reyo ewun ayen da vwo kpahe igabo ayen da vwe ukuko re rhurhu eba re ose rayen ayen de ku opharo fia ayen gbe rha mre eba re ose raye en

quarantined_verses.text: Ri Noa vwo gbunie rhọvwọ rhe o de vughe obo rẹ emọ rọye rẹ itete ivẹ na ru kẹ,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ri noa vwo gbunie rhovwo rhe o de vughe obo re emo roye re itete ive na ru ke

quarantined_verses.text: Oma rẹ ihwo nana kọye ihwo rẹ orhoma rẹ urhie na nurhe. Enana keye emọ ri Jafẹt vwẹ otọ rayen, dohwo depherẹ rọye, vẹ uvwiẹ rayen, vwẹ evun rẹ ẹgborho rayen.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oma re ihwo nana koye ihwo re orhoma re urhie na nurhe enana keye emo ri jafet vwe oto rayen dohwo dephere roye ve uvwie rayen vwe evun re egborho rayen

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da dia ọgban rẹ ibefii rode vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo, fiki rẹ ọtiọye kọye a vwọ tanẹ, Kiri Nimrọd ọgban rẹ ibefi rode vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da dia ogban re ibefii rode vwe obaro re orovwohwo fiki re otioye koye a vwo tane kiri nimrod ogban re ibefi rode vwe obaro re orovwohwo

quarantined_verses.text: Apak-shad kọye rha ọsẹ ri Shelah; Shelah ke rha dia ọsẹ rẹ Eber.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: apak shad koye rha ose ri shelah shelah ke rha dia ose re eber

quarantined_verses.text: Enana eye ekru rẹ emọ ri Noa, kirobo rẹ orua rayen wanre, vwẹ ẹgborho rayen; vwẹ oma rẹ enana kọye ẹgborho rẹ akpọ na ejobi hra nurhe rẹ oghwe na vwọ kponu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: enana eye ekru re emo ri noa kirobo re orua rayen wanre vwe egborho rayen vwe oma re enana koye egborho re akpo na ejobi hra nurhe re oghwe na vwo kponu

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen da ta kẹ ohwohwo, Yanrhe, e jẹn avwanre ma ikori ekpẹn, re anabọ torhẹ ayen. Ayen da vwẹ ikori ekpẹn na vwo ru elalọ, orhọnrhe kọye e vwọ gbe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta ke ohwohwo yanrhe e jen avwanre ma ikori ekpen re anabo torhe ayen ayen da vwe ikori ekpen na vwo ru elalo orhonrhe koye e vwo gbe

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen da rha ta, Yanrhe, e jẹn avwanre bọn orere kẹ oma rẹ avwanre, ra bọn uwevwi rẹ enu phihọ ro kpenu odjuvwu, re avwanre re odẹ kẹ oma rẹ avwanre, ọ rha dia eriyin avwanre ke cha hra vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na ejobi.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen da rha ta yanrhe e jen avwanre bon orere ke oma re avwanre ra bon uwevwi re enu phiho ro kpenu odjuvwu re avwanre re ode ke oma re avwanre o rha dia eriyin avwanre ke cha hra vwe enu re akpo na ejobi

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo de wotọ rhe mrẹ orere na kugbe uwevwi rẹ enu na, rẹ emọ rẹ ihwo rẹ akpọ bọnre na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo de woto rhe mre orere na kugbe uwevwi re enu na re emo re ihwo re akpo bonre na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo da ta, Nighe, ayen ohwo ọvo, ayen ki rhe vwo ephẹrẹ ọvo, Ọnana kẹ ẹtuọhọ rẹ emu rẹ ayen che ru: o gbi vwo emu ọvuọvo rẹ ayen guọnọ ru rọ cha bẹn ayen eruo-o.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta nighe ayen ohwo ovo ayen ki rhe vwo ephere ovo onana ke etuoho re emu re ayen che ru o gbi vwo emu ovuovo re ayen guono ru ro cha ben ayen eruo o

quarantined_verses.text: Gba yanrhe, re wotọ rhe, ra dia Etiyin phi ozighi phihọ ephẹrẹ rayen, rere ayen jẹn ephẹrẹ rẹ ohwo ohwo enyo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: gba yanrhe re woto rhe ra dia etiyin phi ozighi phiho ephere rayen rere ayen jen ephere re ohwo ohwo enyo

quarantined_verses.text: Haran da karo rẹ ọsẹ rọye ghwu vwẹ otọ re de vwiẹ, vwi Ur ri Kaldia.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: haran da karo re ose roye ghwu vwe oto re de vwie vwi ur ri kaldia

quarantined_verses.text: Terah da reyọ Ebram rẹ ọmọ rọye vi Lọt rẹ ọmọ ri Haran, rẹ ovwrọmọ rọye, vi Serai rẹ aye rẹ ọmọ rọye Ebram, ayen ejobi de ku usun phihọ ni Ur ri Kaldia vwo kpo Kenan, ẹkẹvuọvo rẹ ayen vwo te Haran ayen da daji Etiyin.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: terah da reyo ebram re omo roye vi lot re omo ri haran re ovwromo roye vi serai re aye re omo roye ebram ayen ejobi de ku usun phiho ni ur ri kaldia vwo kpo kenan ekevuovo re ayen vwo te haran ayen da daji etiyin

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Ọrovwohwo da vwẹ oma phia kẹ Ebram, ọ da ta, Uvwiẹ wẹn Me cha vwẹ otọ nana kẹ. O da so agbada kẹ Ọrovwohwo rọ vwẹ oma phia kẹ, vwẹ Etiyin na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin orovwohwo da vwe oma phia ke ebram o da ta uvwie wen me cha vwe oto nana ke o da so agbada ke orovwohwo ro vwe oma phia ke vwe etiyin na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ihwo rẹ Ijipt da rhe mrẹ wẹ, kẹ ayen cha tanẹ, Ọnana aye rọye, kẹ ayen che hwe vwe, ayen ki ju we vwo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ihwo re ijipt da rhe mre we ke ayen cha tane onana aye roye ke ayen che hwe vwe ayen ki ju we vwo

quarantined_verses.text: Vwi fiki rọye ọ da nabọ vwẹ ẹro te Ebram, o de vwo igegede, irhuẹn, ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ eshare kugbe erẹ eya, idibo rẹ eshare kugbe emetẹ, kugbe kamẹl.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwi fiki roye o da nabo vwe ero te ebram o de vwo igegede irhuen eketekete re eshare kugbe ere eya idibo re eshare kugbe emete kugbe kamel

quarantined_verses.text: re te asan rẹ Ebram ka so agbada phihọ ẹsosuọ na; Ebram de se odẹ rẹ Ọrovwohwo vwẹ Etiyin.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re te asan re ebram ka so agbada phiho esosuo na ebram de se ode re orovwohwo vwe etiyin

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ ọke nana ihwo ri Sodọm na brare gangan, iruimwemwu ride na vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana ihwo ri sodom na brare gangan iruimwemwu ride na vwe obaro re orovwohwo

quarantined_verses.text: kugbe Họr vwẹ ugbenu ri Seir re te Elparan rọ hẹ ughwru rẹ aton na;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: kugbe hor vwe ugbenu ri seir re te elparan ro he ughwru re aton na

quarantined_verses.text: Ro vwo rhivwi rhe nu ro vwo phi Chedor-laomer, kugbe ivie re vẹ ọye gba obọ kparobọ nu, ovie ri Sodọm da yanran ra vwa vwẹ ushekpotọ ri Shaveh (kọye ese ushekpotọ rẹ Ovie).
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ro vwo rhivwi rhe nu ro vwo phi chedor laomer kugbe ivie re ve oye gba obo kparobo nu ovie ri sodom da yanran ra vwa vwe ushekpoto ri shaveh koye ese ushekpoto re ovie

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ imu nana vwọ wan nu ota rẹ Ọrovwohwo de bru Ebram rhe vwẹ evwerhẹ, Wọ djẹ oshọ-ọ, Ebram, mẹvwẹ ekpọfia wẹn, osa wẹn cha rho gangan.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re imu nana vwo wan nu ota re orovwohwo de bru ebram rhe vwe evwerhe wo dje osho o ebram mevwe ekpofia wen osa wen cha rho gangan

quarantined_verses.text: Nighe, ota rẹ Ọrovwohwo de bro rhe, Ohwo nana cha dia ọriuku wẹ-ẹn, ọmọ rẹ obọ wẹn re cha dia ọriuku wẹn.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: nighe ota re orovwohwo de bro rhe ohwo nana cha dia oriuku we en omo re obo wen re cha dia oriuku wen

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da ta kẹ, Mẹvwẹ Ọrovwohwo rọ reyọ owẹ ni Ur ri Kaldia rhe, ro kẹ wẹ otọ nana vwọ re uku.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke mevwe orovwohwo ro reyo owe ni ur ri kaldia rhe ro ke we oto nana vwo re uku

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ekala vwọ rhan mu ayen re cha vwọ sohrọ ayen, Ebram da djẹ ayen yanran.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ekala vwo rhan mu ayen re cha vwo sohro ayen ebram da dje ayen yanran

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo ke Me cha vwẹ ẹgborho re ayen na vwo guẹdjọ, tavwe ayen ki norhe vẹ eyenre buebu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ke me cha vwe egborho re ayen na vwo guedjo tavwe ayen ki norhe ve eyenre buebu

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ orua rẹ ẹne kẹsiẹye aye ki che rhivwi rhe, fikiridie orukuruku rẹ ihwo rẹ Amọr je gba-a.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe orua re ene kesieye aye ki che rhivwi rhe fikiridie orukuruku re ihwo re amor je gba a

quarantined_verses.text: Kọye, Ebram rhe vwọ dia Kenan ikpe ihwe nure, Serai, aye rẹ Ebram na, da vwi Hagar ohwo rẹ Ijipt ọmọtẹ rọye, vwọ kẹ Ebram ọshare rọye vwọ rọvwọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: koye ebram rhe vwo dia kenan ikpe ihwe nure serai aye re ebram na da vwi hagar ohwo re ijipt omote roye vwo ke ebram oshare roye vwo rovwo

quarantined_verses.text: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo da mrẹ vwẹ asan ogbugbu rẹ ame vwẹ evun rẹ aghwa, ogbugbu rọ orhoma rẹ idjerhe re de kpo Shur na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo da mre vwe asan ogbugbu re ame vwe evun re aghwa ogbugbu ro orhoma re idjerhe re de kpo shur na

quarantined_verses.text: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo na da ta kẹ, Rhivwi bru onini wẹn, ru wọ vwẹ oma kpotọ kẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo na da ta ke rhivwi bru onini wen ru wo vwe oma kpoto ke

quarantined_verses.text: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo na da je ta kẹ, Mi che ru uvwiẹ wẹn buebu gangan re de je se kere.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo na da je ta ke mi che ru uvwie wen buebu gangan re de je se kere

quarantined_verses.text: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo na da ta kẹ, Nighere, wọ mrevun, ku wo vwiẹ ọmọshare, gbe se odẹ rọye Ishmael, fikiridie Ọrovwohwo nyo oja wẹn re.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo na da ta ke nighere wo mrevun ku wo vwie omoshare gbe se ode roye ishmael fikiridie orovwohwo nyo oja wen re

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ Ebram vwọ ikpe ọvo nuro vwẹ ujori re Ọrovwohwo da vwẹ oma phia kẹ Ebram, ọ da ta kẹ, Mẹvwẹ Ọghẹnẹ ro vwo Ẹgba, yan nene uvwe, wo gbe ẹgua-a.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ebram vwo ikpe ovo nuro vwe ujori re orovwohwo da vwe oma phia ke ebram o da ta ke mevwe oghene ro vwo egba yan nene uvwe wo gbe egua a

quarantined_verses.text: Ebram de she bọvwọ opharo rhuotọ, Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ebram de she bovwo opharo rhuoto oghene da ta ke

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ ro te ẹdẹ ẹrenren nure vwẹ usun rẹ ovwan ka yanvwọ; kọshare kọshare vwẹ uvwiẹ wẹn ejobi, ọ re vwiẹri vwẹ uwevwi wẹn eyẹ ọ ra vwẹ igho dẹ eyẹ ọrharha rọ dia uwviẹ wẹ-ẹn.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o ro te ede erenren nure vwe usun re ovwan ka yanvwo koshare koshare vwe uvwie wen ejobi o re vwieri vwe uwevwi wen eye o ra vwe igho de eye orharha ro dia uwvie we en

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Ebraham da reyọ Ishmael rẹ ọmọ rọye na kugbe ibiẹdo rọye re vwiẹ vwẹ uwevwi rọye eyẹ eviẹn ra vwẹ igho dẹ, kọshare kọshare vwẹ evun rẹ uwevwi rẹ Ebraham na, ọ da yanvwe ayen ejobi vwẹ ẹdẹ yena ọvuọvo na, kirobo rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ta kẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham da reyo ishmael re omo roye na kugbe ibiedo roye re vwie vwe uwevwi roye eye evien ra vwe igho de koshare koshare vwe evun re uwevwi re ebraham na o da yanvwe ayen ejobi vwe ede yena ovuovo na kirobo re oghene ta ke

quarantined_verses.text: Ishmael rẹ ọmọ rọye da dia ikpe ihwerha ọke rọ vwọ yanvwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ishmael re omo roye da dia ikpe ihwerha oke ro vwo yanvwe

quarantined_verses.text: te ire vwiẹri vwẹ uwevwi rọye te e ra vwẹ igho dẹ mie erhorha, a da yanvwe ayen ejobi kugbe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: te ire vwieri vwe uwevwi roye te e ra vwe igho de mie erhorha a da yanvwe ayen ejobi kugbe

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo da vwẹ oma phia kẹ vwẹ oma rẹ ọhahe ri Mamre, ro vwo tidia anurhoro rẹ utughẹ rọye vwẹ oghẹruvo na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da vwe oma phia ke vwe oma re ohahe ri mamre ro vwo tidia anurhoro re utughe roye vwe ogheruvo na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ vwọ kparo ni, nighe eshare erha mudia vwẹ obaro rọye. Ọke rọ vwọ mrẹ ayen, ọ da djẹ nẹ anurhoro rẹ utughẹ na ra vwa ayen, o de diguẹ kẹ ayen,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o vwo kparo ni nighe eshare erha mudia vwe obaro roye oke ro vwo mre ayen o da dje ne anurhoro re utughe na ra vwa ayen o de digue ke ayen

quarantined_verses.text: re Me ra guọnọ eme emu rhe ru we vwo te unu, re wa ke wanvrẹn kidie ọ guakẹ ovwan ghwa vwẹriẹ asan rẹ odibo wẹn nure. Kọye ayen da ta kẹ nẹ, Gbe ru kiri obo rẹ wo tare na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re me ra guono eme emu rhe ru we vwo te unu re wa ke wanvren kidie o guake ovwan ghwa vwerie asan re odibo wen nure koye ayen da ta ke ne gbe ru kiri obo re wo tare na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da ta, Uyota Me cha rhoma rhe vwẹ asan evwru, Sera rẹ aye wẹn na che vwiẹ ọmọshare. Yi Sera ra kerhọ vwẹ anurhoro rẹ utughẹ na
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da ta uyota me cha rhoma rhe vwe asan evwru sera re aye wen na che vwie omoshare yi sera ra kerho vwe anurhoro re utughe na

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹjo, kidie Me jẹrẹ reyọ nure, nẹ oyono emọ rọye vẹ evwruwevwi rọye ejobi re ayen sẹro rẹ idjerhe rẹ Ọrovwohwo re ayen ru uruemu rẹ ọvwata vẹ ọsoso; rere ive rẹ Ọrovwohwo vẹ kẹ Ebraham na o vwo se ruo gba kẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ejo kidie me jere reyo nure ne oyono emo roye ve evwruwevwi roye ejobi re ayen sero re idjerhe re orovwohwo re ayen ru uruemu re ovwata ve ososo rere ive re orovwohwo ve ke ebraham na o vwo se ruo gba ke

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo da ta, Me da sa mrẹ evwata ujuvẹ gbẹ ihwe vwi Sodọm, ki mi ji asan na vwo vwi fiki rẹ ayen.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da ta me da sa mre evwata ujuve gbe ihwe vwi sodom ki mi ji asan na vwo vwi fiki re ayen

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da rhoma ta kẹ nẹ, Ọ da dianẹ a mrẹ ujuvẹ vwọ. Ọ da kpahe, Vwi fiki rẹ ujuvẹ na mi se ruo-o.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da rhoma ta ke ne o da diane a mre ujuve vwo o da kpahe vwi fiki re ujuve na mi se ruo o

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo da yanran, vwẹ ọke rẹ Ebraham vẹ ọye vwọ ta ota nu: Ebraham de rhivwi kpo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da yanran vwe oke re ebraham ve oye vwo ta ota nu ebraham de rhivwi kpo

quarantined_verses.text: Emakashe ivẹ na de rhi te Sodọm vwẹ ovwọnvwọn, yi Lọt tidia ughere ri Sodọm, Ri Lọt vwọ mrẹ ayen, o de vrẹn ra vwa ayen, o de diguẹ bọvwọ opharo rhu otọ,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: emakashe ive na de rhi te sodom vwe ovwonvwon yi lot tidia ughere ri sodom ri lot vwo mre ayen o de vren ra vwa ayen o de digue bovwo opharo rhu oto

quarantined_verses.text: Nighe, mi vwo emetẹ ivẹ re je riẹn ọshare-e, ju vwe vwẹ ayen kẹ ovwan, ru we ru ayen obo ri je ovwan, ẹkẹvuọvo wa vwẹ obọ te erhorha mẹ na-a, kidie uwevwi mẹ ayen rhi wo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: nighe mi vwo emete ive re je rien oshare e ju vwe vwe ayen ke ovwan ru we ru ayen obo ri je ovwan ekevuovo wa vwe obo te erhorha me na a kidie uwevwi me ayen rhi wo

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo ayen da ta, Si te obuko, Ayen da tanẹ, Ohwo nana ro suosuo rhe na, kọye cha vwẹ oma ru obrorhiẹ, Avwanre vwẹ ẹro wẹn mrẹ oja nọ obo ri Me ru kẹ ihwo nana. Etiyin ayen de keke Lọt mu egba, kẹ ayen nyẹ ẹchẹ na re ọbẹre.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ayen da ta si te obuko ayen da tane ohwo nana ro suosuo rhe na koye cha vwe oma ru obrorhie avwanre vwe ero wen mre oja no obo ri me ru ke ihwo nana etiyin ayen de keke lot mu egba ke ayen nye eche na re obere

quarantined_verses.text: fikiridie avwanre cha ghwọrọ etinẹ na, kidie edo rẹ orukuruku rẹ ihwo nana rhi duvwu erhọ rẹ Ọrovwohwo, Ọrovwohwo kọye ri ji avwanre rhe re ghwọrọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: fikiridie avwanre cha ghworo etine na kidie edo re orukuruku re ihwo nana rhi duvwu erho re orovwohwo orovwohwo koye ri ji avwanre rhe re ghworo na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ayen vwọ reyọ ayen phihọ uphephẹ nu, ayen da ta, Djẹ kẹ arhọ wẹn, we nẹ obuko-o eyẹ we mudia vwẹ ukpotọ na-a, djẹ kpo obo ugbenu na, wa da ghwọrọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ayen vwo reyo ayen phiho uphephe nu ayen da ta dje ke arho wen we ne obuko o eye we mudia vwe ukpoto na a dje kpo obo ugbenu na wa da ghworo

quarantined_verses.text: Lọt da ta kẹ ayen, E, ẹjo, irivwovwe,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: lot da ta ke ayen e ejo irivwovwe

quarantined_verses.text: nighe, ọviẹn wẹn mrẹ aruesiri vwẹ obọ wẹn nure, we ni aruẹdọn mẹ gangan ri we vwo sivwi arhọ mẹ, yẹ ẹkẹvuọvo Me sa djẹ kpo obo igbenu na-a, ughwu de ke vwe phihọ, mi de rhe ghwu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: nighe ovien wen mre aruesiri vwe obo wen nure we ni aruedon me gangan ri we vwo sivwi arho me ye ekevuovo me sa dje kpo obo igbenu na a ughwu de ke vwe phiho mi de rhe ghwu

quarantined_verses.text: Ọnre ghwa vacha vwẹ ọke ri Lọt vwo te Zoar.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: onre ghwa vacha vwe oke ri lot vwo te zoar

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Ọrovwohwo da rhọ osio rẹ ibieragha vẹ erhanre phihọ Sodọm vi Gomora nẹ obo odjuvwu rhe,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin orovwohwo da rho osio re ibieragha ve erhanre phiho sodom vi gomora ne obo odjuvwu rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ rẹ ọkpako da ta kẹ ọ rẹ otete, Ọsẹ rẹ avwanre ghwo re, yẹ o vwo ohwo ọvuọvo vwẹ akpọ na ro bru avwanre rhe kirobo re ruẹ vwẹ akpọ na-a.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o re okpako da ta ke o re otete ose re avwanre ghwo re ye o vwo ohwo ovuovo vwe akpo na ro bru avwanre rhe kirobo re rue vwe akpo na a

quarantined_verses.text: Yanrhe, re avwanre vwẹ idi kẹ da, rere avwanre wan oma rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre vwo emọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: yanrhe re avwanre vwe idi ke da rere avwanre wan oma re ose re avwanre vwo emo

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ rẹ ọkpako na de vwiẹ ọmọshare, o de se odẹ rọye Moab, kọye ọsẹ rẹ ihwo ri Moab rhi te nonẹ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o re okpako na de vwie omoshare o de se ode roye moab koye ose re ihwo ri moab rhi te none na

quarantined_verses.text: Ebraham da ta, Mi ruro fikiridie mi rori nẹ, Oshọ ẹdjẹ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ọ etinẹ-ẹ, ayen de rhe hwe vwe fiki rẹ aye mẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ebraham da ta mi ruro fikiridie mi rori ne osho edje re oghene o etine e ayen de rhe hwe vwe fiki re aye me

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da ta kẹ Sera nẹ, Nighe, Me vwẹ ikpahọ ujori ihwe rẹ idọnọ efuanfon vwọ kẹ oniọvo wẹn re, Ọnana igho rẹ arhuẹrẹ wẹn vwọ kẹ ihwo rẹ ovwan, kohwo kohwo rẹ oma wẹn ejobi Me vẹ ayen rhuẹrẹ kugbe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke sera ne nighe me vwe ikpaho ujori ihwe re idono efuanfon vwo ke oniovo wen re onana igho re arhuere wen vwo ke ihwo re ovwan kohwo kohwo re oma wen ejobi me ve ayen rhuere kugbe

quarantined_verses.text: Ọmọ na da rhe rho, o de rhi bro evie; Ebraham de rhi chere emu buebu vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ Aizik vwo bru evie nu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: omo na da rhe rho o de rhi bro evie ebraham de rhi chere emu buebu vwe ede re aizik vwo bru evie nu

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo Sera da mrẹ ọmọ ri Hagar rẹ ohwo rẹ Ijipt na, ro vwiẹ vwọ kẹ Ebraham na, rọ vẹ Aizik rẹ ọmọ rọye gba ha eha.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo sera da mre omo ri hagar re ohwo re ijipt na ro vwie vwo ke ebraham na ro ve aizik re omo roye gba ha eha

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ Ebraham, Wo jẹ Ọnana tun we oma vwi fiki rẹ ọmọ na vẹ aye na rẹ ọviẹn na-a; obo ri Sera ta kẹ wẹ ejobi, ru kirobo rọ tare kidie oma rẹ Aizik ọye uvwiẹ wẹn de che vwo odẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oghene da ta ke ebraham wo je onana tun we oma vwi fiki re omo na ve aye na re ovien na a obo ri sera ta ke we ejobi ru kirobo ro tare kidie oma re aizik oye uvwie wen de che vwo ode

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da yanran re tidia tephe vwẹ ogboko kẹ ọmọ na vwẹ uvwre rẹ asan rẹ umurhabọ sa yan te, kidie ọ tare ne, E ju vwe mrẹ orivwi rẹ ọmọ na-a. Ọke ro vwo tidia oboyi ro vwo no re, ọmọ na da teye ugoroviẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da yanran re tidia tephe vwe ogboko ke omo na vwe uvwre re asan re umurhabo sa yan te kidie o tare ne e ju vwe mre orivwi re omo na a oke ro vwo tidia oboyi ro vwo no re omo na da teye ugorovie

quarantined_verses.text: Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e de se asan na Bẹẹrsheba, fikiridie Etiyin ayen ihwo ivẹ na da re ọphọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: fiki re otioye na e de se asan na beersheba fikiridie etiyin ayen ihwo ive na da re opho

quarantined_verses.text: Ebraham da reyọ ekrirhe re vọ izobo rẹ ẹtorhẹ na, o de muo kpahọ ọmọ rọye Aizik, ọ da yọnrọn utuerhanre kugbe aphia vwẹ obọ. Kọye ayen ivẹ na de ku usun phihọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ebraham da reyo ekrirhe re vo izobo re etorhe na o de muo kpaho omo roye aizik o da yonron utuerhanre kugbe aphia vwe obo koye ayen ive na de ku usun phiho

quarantined_verses.text: Ebraham da ta, Ọghẹnẹ ọvo che bibi egbo rẹ izobo rẹ ẹtorhẹ na rhe ọmọ mẹ. Kọye ayen ivẹ na de ku usun họ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ebraham da ta oghene ovo che bibi egbo re izobo re etorhe na rhe omo me koye ayen ive na de ku usun ho

quarantined_verses.text: Amakashe rẹ Ọrovwohwo da rhoma se obọ rivẹ nẹ obo odjuvwu rhe,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: amakashe re orovwohwo da rhoma se obo rive ne obo odjuvwu rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Ki mi bruphihọ kẹ wẹ, ki mi ru uvwiẹ wẹn buphihọ kiri isio rẹ obo odjuvwu kiri ibiekpẹn re orhoma rẹ urhie. Uvwiẹ wẹn ke cha vwẹ anurhoro rẹ ivwighrẹ rayen riuku,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ki mi bruphiho ke we ki mi ru uvwie wen buphiho kiri isio re obo odjuvwu kiri ibiekpen re orhoma re urhie uvwie wen ke cha vwe anurhoro re ivwighre rayen riuku

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke yena yi Efrọn tidia vwẹ ohri rẹ ihwo ri Hẹt na, Efrọn rẹ ohwo ri Hẹt na da kpahe kẹ Ebraham vwẹ irharo rẹ ihwo ri Hẹt ejobi, vwẹ obọ rẹ ihwo ri kpo ughere rẹ orere na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke yena yi efron tidia vwe ohri re ihwo ri het na efron re ohwo ri het na da kpahe ke ebraham vwe irharo re ihwo ri het ejobi vwe obo re ihwo ri kpo ughere re orere na

quarantined_verses.text: ke Me vwo owẹ duvwu iyori vwẹ odẹ rẹ Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ rẹ odjuvwu vẹ akpọ, ne wọ sa reyọ aye rọ dia ọmọtẹ rẹ ihwo ri Kenan, re Me dia uherevie ayen na, vwọ kẹ ọmọ mẹ-ẹ,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ke me vwo owe duvwu iyori vwe ode re orovwohwo oghene re odjuvwu ve akpo ne wo sa reyo aye ro dia omote re ihwo ri kenan re me dia uherevie ayen na vwo ke omo me e

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da vwẹ iyesi na shevwerhẹ otọ vwẹ ughere rẹ orere na vwẹ orhoma rẹ orhare vwẹ ọke rẹ ovwọnvwọn, rẹ eya vwo kpo ame evo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da vwe iyesi na shevwerhe oto vwe ughere re orere na vwe orhoma re orhare vwe oke re ovwonvwon re eya vwo kpo ame evo

quarantined_verses.text: Gbe jẹ ọmọtẹ re Me cha ta kẹ nẹ, Biko vo ame kẹ vwẹ re Me da, rọ rha wene unu tanẹ, Da, ri mi ji vo kẹ iyesi na - dia aye ru wọ rhuẹrẹ phihọ kẹ odibo wẹn Aizik. Ọnana kọye o vwo mu vwe ẹro nẹ evuesiri wẹn na vẹ onini mẹ herọ
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: gbe je omote re me cha ta ke ne biko vo ame ke vwe re me da ro rha wene unu tane da ri mi ji vo ke iyesi na dia aye ru wo rhuere phiho ke odibo wen aizik onana koye o vwo mu vwe ero ne evuesiri wen na ve onini me hero

quarantined_verses.text: ọ da ta, Ta kẹ vwẹ, wẹ ọmọtẹ rẹ ono. Uwevwi herọ vwẹ egodo rẹ ọsẹ wẹn re wo phihọ?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da ta ta ke vwe we omote re ono uwevwi hero vwe egodo re ose wen re wo phiho

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da ta kẹ, Mẹvwẹ ọmọtẹ ri Bẹtuẹl rẹ ọmọ ri Milka, ro vwiẹ ki Nahọr.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke mevwe omote ri betuel re omo ri milka ro vwie ki nahor

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin ohwo na da rhe uwevwi; Laban da rhan iyesi na, ọ da vwọ egbri vẹ ẹbe eyaya vwọ kẹ ayen, ọ da vwẹ ame kẹ vwọ hworhẹ awọ kugbe awọ rẹ ihwo ri nenire.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin ohwo na da rhe uwevwi laban da rhan iyesi na o da vwo egbri ve ebe eyaya vwo ke ayen o da vwe ame ke vwo hworhe awo kugbe awo re ihwo ri nenire

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ odibo rẹ Ebraham vwo nyo eta nana, ọ da vwẹ uyovwi te otọ vwọ kẹ Ọrovwohwo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re odibo re ebraham vwo nyo eta nana o da vwe uyovwi te oto vwo ke orovwohwo

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Wa da vwẹ jẹ-ẹ, rẹ Ọrovwohwo vwo ru oyan mẹ yovwi nure na, ju vwe kpo bru onini mẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo o da ta ke ayen wa da vwe je e re orovwohwo vwo ru oyan me yovwi nure na ju vwe kpo bru onini me

quarantined_verses.text: Aizik ko kpo umẹ ese vwẹ asan ofuefu vwẹ ovwọnvwọn yena, ọ vwọ kpare opharo, nighe usun rẹ iyesi ra gua cha.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: aizik ko kpo ume ese vwe asan ofuefu vwe ovwonvwon yena o vwo kpare opharo nighe usun re iyesi ra gua cha

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo emọ rẹ ayeobọ na ejobi ẹse kọye o di ru kẹ ayen, ọke rẹ ekpuyovwi rọye vwọ akpọ na ọ da hẹriẹ ayen abọ nẹ oma rẹ Aizik, vwo kpo orho rọ abọ rẹ ọnre da vacha.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo emo re ayeobo na ejobi ese koye o di ru ke ayen oke re ekpuyovwi roye vwo akpo na o da herie ayen abo ne oma re aizik vwo kpo orho ro abo re onre da vacha

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹdẹ rẹ uvwiẹ rọye vwọ gba, nighe, agbava evun rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ede re uvwie roye vwo gba nighe agbava evun roye

quarantined_verses.text: Ivun rẹ Isọ vwerhe Aizik gangan, fikiridie o hwe eranvwe kẹ na; ẹkẹvuọvo ivun ri Jekọp da rha vwerhe Rebeka.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ivun re iso vwerhe aizik gangan fikiridie o hwe eranvwe ke na ekevuovo ivun ri jekop da rha vwerhe rebeka

quarantined_verses.text: Ki mi ru uvwiẹ wẹn bu kiri isio ri obenu, ke Me vwẹ etọ nana ejobi na vwọ kẹ uvwiẹ wẹn; vwẹ oma rẹ uvwiẹ wẹn ọye ẹgborho rẹ akpọ na ejobi de vwo ebruphihọ kẹ oma rayen:
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ki mi ru uvwie wen bu kiri isio ri obenu ke me vwe eto nana ejobi na vwo ke uvwie wen vwe oma re uvwie wen oye egborho re akpo na ejobi de vwo ebruphiho ke oma rayen

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọke rẹ idibo rẹ Aizik vwọ tọn ushekpotọ na ayen da mrẹ orhare rẹ ogbugbu rẹ ame,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oke re idibo re aizik vwo ton ushekpoto na ayen da mre orhare re ogbugbu re ame

quarantined_verses.text: Ọrovwohwo da vwẹ oma phia kẹ vwẹ ason yena ọ da ta, Mẹvwẹ Ọghẹnẹ rẹ Ebraham rẹ ọsẹ wẹn, wọ djoshọ-ọ, kidie Me vẹ owẹ herọ ki mi bruphihọ kẹ wẹ uvwiẹ wẹn ko bu phihọ fiki rẹ odibo mẹ Ebraham.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da vwe oma phia ke vwe ason yena o da ta mevwe oghene re ebraham re ose wen wo djosho o kidie me ve owe hero ki mi bruphiho ke we uvwie wen ko bu phiho fiki re odibo me ebraham

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen da ta, Avwanre mrẹre phẹphẹ nẹ Ọrovwohwo vẹ owẹ herọ, kọye avwanre vwọ tanẹ, e jẹ avwanre duvwu iyori kẹ oma, rere avwanre vẹ owẹ re ọphọ,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta avwanre mrere phephe ne orovwohwo ve owe hero koye avwanre vwo tane e je avwanre duvwu iyori ke oma rere avwanre ve owe re opho

quarantined_verses.text: nẹ wo kpokpo avwanre-e, kirobo rẹ avwanre vwẹ obọ te we-e, Me ji ru we emuọvo-o jokpa rẹ uyoyovwi avwanre ki rhe siobọ nẹ uwe kpo egberhẹnẹdẹ. Asakiephana wẹ kẹ ohwo rẹ Ọrovwohwo bruphihọ kẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ne wo kpokpo avwanre e kirobo re avwanre vwe obo te we e me ji ru we emuovo o jokpa re uyoyovwi avwanre ki rhe siobo ne uwe kpo egberhenede asakiephana we ke ohwo re orovwohwo bruphiho ke

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ enẹna, gba reyọ ekuakua wẹn, ekpo rẹ edada wẹn, kugbe umurhabọ wẹn, ru wo kpo aghwa, ra bẹre ibefi ru wo hwe eranvwe rhe vwe,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe enena gba reyo ekuakua wen ekpo re edada wen kugbe umurhabo wen ru wo kpo aghwa ra bere ibefi ru wo hwe eranvwe rhe vwe

quarantined_verses.text: ru wo chere emu ọvwevwerhe kẹ vwẹ, emu rọ vwerhe ovwẹ, ru wo muo rhe vwe re Me re, rere Me nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ wẹ mi ki ghwu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ru wo chere emu ovwevwerhe ke vwe emu ro vwerhe ovwe ru wo muo rhe vwe re me re rere me ne erhovwo ke we mi ki ghwu

quarantined_verses.text: Hwe eranvwe rhe vwe, rere wo vwo chere emu ọvwevwerhe, rere Me riọ, re Me nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ wẹ vwẹ irharo rẹ Ọrovwohwo tavwe mi ki ghwu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: hwe eranvwe rhe vwe rere wo vwo chere emu ovwevwerhe rere me rio re me ne erhovwo ke we vwe irharo re orovwohwo tavwe mi ki ghwu

quarantined_verses.text: Ọkeọvo ọsẹ mẹ cha vwẹ obọ te vwe, ke Me họhọ ohwo rọ vwọ jehwẹ, ke Me vwo eka kẹ oma mẹ ọ rha dia ẹrhovwo-o.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: okeovo ose me cha vwe obo te vwe ke me hoho ohwo ro vwo jehwe ke me vwo eka ke oma me o rha dia erhovwo o

quarantined_verses.text: Jẹn ihwo ga wẹ, irere ki shiguẹ kẹ wẹ. Ku wọ dia olori vwẹ enu rẹ iniọvo wẹn Jẹn emọ rẹ oni wẹn vwẹ uyovwi te otọ kẹ wẹ. Eka kẹ ohwo rọ harha owẹ Ẹrhovwo kẹ ohwo rọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ wẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jen ihwo ga we irere ki shigue ke we ku wo dia olori vwe enu re iniovo wen jen emo re oni wen vwe uyovwi te oto ke we eka ke ohwo ro harha owe erhovwo ke ohwo ro ne erhovwo ke we

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ Aizik ghwa vwọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ Jekọp nu, ri Jekọp ghwa vwọ ro otafe nẹ obaro rẹ ọsẹ rọye nu, Isọ rẹ oniọvo rọye na de ghwe nẹ ibefi rhe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re aizik ghwa vwo ne erhovwo ke jekop nu ri jekop ghwa vwo ro otafe ne obaro re ose roye nu iso re oniovo roye na de ghwe ne ibefi rhe

quarantined_verses.text: O de ji chere emu ọvwevwerhe, o de muo rhe ọsẹ rọye, Ọ da ta kẹ ọsẹ rọye, Gbe ji Baba vrẹn, re ọ re eranvwe rẹ ọmọ rọye, re wọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ vwẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o de ji chere emu ovwevwerhe o de muo rhe ose roye o da ta ke ose roye gbe ji baba vren re o re eranvwe re omo roye re wo ne erhovwo ke vwe

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da ta kẹ, Oniọvo wẹn ọ vwẹ ophiẹvwe rhe, ọ da reyọ ẹrhovwo wẹn mie we.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo o da ta ke oniovo wen o vwe ophievwe rhe o da reyo erhovwo wen mie we

quarantined_verses.text: Isọ da ta, Oteri re vwo se Jekọp? Kidie Etiyin asiava ọ vwẹ ona ru vwe re. O mie vwe ọkpako mẹ, gbe rhe nighe ọ rha je reyọ ẹrhovwo Me re. O da rhoma ta kẹ, Wo rhe ji ẹmẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ vwẹ-ẹ?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: iso da ta oteri re vwo se jekop kidie etiyin asiava o vwe ona ru vwe re o mie vwe okpako me gbe rhe nighe o rha je reyo erhovwo me re o da rhoma ta ke wo rhe ji eme erhovwo ke vwe e

quarantined_verses.text: bẹsiẹ rẹ ophun rẹ oniọvo wẹn vwo fue, rẹ obo ri wo ruro vwọ choẹro, ki mi ji ohwo ra reyọ owẹ nẹ oboyi rhe. Mavọ emọ rẹ ọmiọvwọ ivẹ ghwẹ ukpẹdọke?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: besie re ophun re oniovo wen vwo fue re obo ri wo ruro vwo choero ki mi ji ohwo ra reyo owe ne oboyi rhe mavo emo re omiovwo ive ghwe ukpedoke

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ Isọ vwọ mrẹ nẹ aye ri Kenan je Aizik rẹ ọsẹ rọye-e,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re iso vwo mre ne aye ri kenan je aizik re ose roye e

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Jekọp de vrẹn vwẹ irhiọke ride, ọ da reyọ ubioragha na rọ vwọ cha uyovwi jovwo na vwo viotọ o de ku evwri ku enu rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop de vren vwe irhioke ride o da reyo ubioragha na ro vwo cha uyovwi jovwo na vwo vioto o de ku evwri ku enu roye

quarantined_verses.text: Rọ vwọ kpare opharo, ọ da mrẹ orhare vwẹ evun rẹ ẹghwa, o vwo ni, ekru rẹ igodẹ erha rhuẹn kẹrẹ; kidie ame rẹ orhare na ọye igodẹ na da. Oragha rọ unu rọye na pha rhuarho,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ro vwo kpare opharo o da mre orhare vwe evun re eghwa o vwo ni ekru re igode erha rhuen kere kidie ame re orhare na oye igode na da oragha ro unu roye na pha rhuarho

quarantined_verses.text: Rọ je vwọ ta ota na kẹ ayen na, Rachel vẹ igodẹ rẹ ọsẹ rọye da yan rhe, fikiridie ọye re sẹro rẹ ayen.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ro je vwo ta ota na ke ayen na rachel ve igode re ose roye da yan rhe fikiridie oye re sero re ayen

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke ri Jekọp vwọ mrẹ Rachel rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Laban rẹ oniọvo rẹ oni rọye, kugbe igodẹ ri Laban rẹ oniọvo rẹ oni rọye, Jekọp da yanran re ghorie oragha na nẹ unu rẹ orhare na, ọ da vwẹ ame kẹ igodẹ ri Laban oniọvo rẹ oni rọye da.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke ri jekop vwo mre rachel re omote ri laban re oniovo re oni roye kugbe igode ri laban re oniovo re oni roye jekop da yanran re ghorie oragha na ne unu re orhare na o da vwe ame ke igode ri laban oniovo re oni roye da

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ ọke yena Laban vwo emetẹ ivẹ, odẹ rẹ oro ọkpako Leah, odẹ rẹ ọro otete ki Rachel.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe oke yena laban vwo emete ive ode re oro okpako leah ode re oro otete ki rachel

quarantined_verses.text: Laban da ta, E ruẹ ọtiọye vwẹ orho rẹ avwanre-e, a ka vwẹ omotete brọgọ je ọkpako otọ-ọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: laban da ta e rue otioye vwe orho re avwanre e a ka vwe omotete brogo je okpako oto o

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ Ọrovwohwo vwọ mrẹ nẹ ivun ri Leah sa vwerhe Jekọp te-e, o de rhie urhoro rẹ emọ kẹ, ẹkẹvuọvo Rachel kẹ ẹga.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re orovwohwo vwo mre ne ivun ri leah sa vwerhe jekop te e o de rhie urhoro re emo ke ekevuovo rachel ke ega

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke ri Rachel vwọ mrẹ nẹ ọye rhe vwiẹ-ẹ, kọ rioma kpahe oniọvo rọye; ọ da ta ki Jekọp nẹ, Kẹ vwẹ ọmọ, ọ rha dia ọtiọye ki mi ghwu;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke ri rachel vwo mre ne oye rhe vwie e ko rioma kpahe oniovo roye o da ta ki jekop ne ke vwe omo o rha dia otioye ki mi ghwu

quarantined_verses.text: Ri Leah rha vwọ mrẹ nẹ ọye gbi vwiẹ-ẹ, ọ da reyọ ọmọtẹ rọye Zilpah vwọ ki Jekọp vwọ rọvwọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ri leah rha vwo mre ne oye gbi vwie e o da reyo omote roye zilpah vwo ki jekop vwo rovwo

quarantined_verses.text: Ri Jekọp vwo nẹ ẹghwa rhe vwẹ ovwọnvwọn Leah da ra vwa, ọ da ta, Wo bru vwe rhe ovwerhẹ, kidie Me vwẹ ivwritegbo re ọmọ mẹ vwọ yaro wẹ. Kọye o de nene vwerhẹ vwẹ ason yena.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ri jekop vwo ne eghwa rhe vwe ovwonvwon leah da ra vwa o da ta wo bru vwe rhe ovwerhe kidie me vwe ivwritegbo re omo me vwo yaro we koye o de nene vwerhe vwe ason yena

quarantined_verses.text: Leah da rhoma mrevun, o de vwiẹ ọmọshare rẹ esan vwọ ki Jekọp.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: leah da rhoma mrevun o de vwie omoshare re esan vwo ki jekop

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da vwẹ oghọ ro keri fuanfon na vwọ rẹrẹ asan rẹ igodẹ na da da ame. Kidie ẹvo vwiẹ vwẹ asan rẹ ayen da da ame na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da vwe ogho ro keri fuanfon na vwo rere asan re igode na da da ame kidie evo vwie vwe asan re ayen da da ame na

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ ọke yena Jekọp de nyo rẹ emọ ri Laban vwọ tanẹ, Jekọp ghwe eyere rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre reyọ, eyere rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre na kọye o vwo fe na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe oke yena jekop de nyo re emo ri laban vwo tane jekop ghwe eyere re ose re avwanre reyo eyere re ose re avwanre na koye o vwo fe na

quarantined_verses.text: ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Ivun mẹ gbe sa vwerhe ọsẹ rẹ ovwan kirobo ri jovwo-o. Ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ mẹ na vẹ ovwẹ herọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke ayen ivun me gbe sa vwerhe ose re ovwan kirobo ri jovwo o ekevuovo oghene re ose me na ve ovwe hero

quarantined_verses.text: Etiọye na Ọghẹnẹ vwọ reyọ uchuru rẹ ọsẹ wẹn ọ da vwẹ ayen kẹ vwẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etioye na oghene vwo reyo uchuru re ose wen o da vwe ayen ke vwe

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Rachel vi Leah da kpahe kẹ, Ẹkẹn ọfa eyẹ uku ji chekọ kẹ avwanre vwẹ uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin rachel vi leah da kpahe ke eken ofa eye uku ji cheko ke avwanre vwe uwevwi re ose re avwanre

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke ra vwọ vuẹ Laban vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ erha nẹ Jekọp djẹre,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke ra vwo vue laban vwe ede re erha ne jekop djere

quarantined_verses.text: Ogangan rhe vwe mi vwo ru we ghwaghwa; ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ wẹn ọye vuẹ vwẹ vwẹ ason na, nẹ, Jomaotọ wọ ta ota oyoyovwi eyẹ ọbrabra ki Jekọpu-u.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ogangan rhe vwe mi vwo ru we ghwaghwa ekevuovo oghene re ose wen oye vue vwe vwe ason na ne jomaoto wo ta ota oyoyovwi eye obrabra ki jekopu u

quarantined_verses.text: Jekọp da kpahe ki Laban, Kidie oshọ mu vwe, ki mi rori nẹ wọ cha vwẹ ẹgba reyọ emetẹ wẹn mie vwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jekop da kpahe ki laban kidie osho mu vwe ki mi rori ne wo cha vwe egba reyo emete wen mie vwe

quarantined_verses.text: Laban de nyo ọ da kpahe ki Jekọp; Emetẹ na emọmẹọ, emọ rayen na emọ mẹ, uchuru na ji emẹ rhe, emu ejobi ru wọ mrẹ na emẹ. Ẹkẹvuọvo kidie mi se ru nonẹ na vwọ kẹ emetẹ mẹ na, eyẹ vwọ kẹ emọ rayen vwiẹri?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: laban de nyo o da kpahe ki jekop emete na emomeo emo rayen na emo me uchuru na ji eme rhe emu ejobi ru wo mre na eme ekevuovo kidie mi se ru none na vwo ke emete me na eye vwo ke emo rayen vwieri

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ rẹ Ebraham kugbe Ọghẹnẹ ri Nahọr, Ọghẹnẹ rẹ esẹ rayen, brorhiẹ rẹ avwanre. Etiyin Jekọp da vwẹ Oshọ rẹ ọsẹ rọye Aizik vwo duvwu iyori.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene re ebraham kugbe oghene ri nahor oghene re ese rayen brorhie re avwanre etiyin jekop da vwe osho re ose roye aizik vwo duvwu iyori

quarantined_verses.text: Jekọp vwọ yanran vwẹ idjerhe emakashe rẹ Ọghẹnẹ da vwa;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jekop vwo yanran vwe idjerhe emakashe re oghene da vwa

quarantined_verses.text: Ikọ na de rhivwi bru Jekọp rhe tanẹ, Avwanre te asan rẹ oniọvo wẹn Isọ, okpuyovwi rọye cha vwa wẹ, kugbe ihwo uri ivẹ ri nenire.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: iko na de rhivwi bru jekop rhe tane avwanre te asan re oniovo wen iso okpuyovwi roye cha vwa we kugbe ihwo uri ive ri nenire

quarantined_verses.text: Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na emọ rẹ Izrẹl gbe re uriẹn rẹ ekpogho owọ-ọ rhi te nonẹ, kidie ọ vwẹ obọ te uriẹn rẹ ekpogho owọ ri Jekọp
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: fiki re otioye na emo re izrel gbe re urien re ekpogho owo o rhi te none kidie o vwe obo te urien re ekpogho owo ri jekop

quarantined_verses.text: Jẹn ọrovwovwe ka obaro kẹ odibo rọye, rere Me jomaotọ sun ayen rhe, rere Me tẹtẹ ayen rhe kirobo rẹ uchuru na sa yan te, kirobo rẹ emọ na sa yan te, bẹsiẹ Me cha vwọ yan mu ọrovwovwe vwẹ obi Seir.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jen orovwovwe ka obaro ke odibo roye rere me jomaoto sun ayen rhe rere me tete ayen rhe kirobo re uchuru na sa yan te kirobo re emo na sa yan te besie me cha vwo yan mu orovwovwe vwe obi seir

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Isọ da ta, Gbe ju vwe yan jẹn ihwo mẹ ẹvo vwo kẹ wẹ. Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da ta, Kidie Me vwẹ ayen ru? Ju vwe mrẹ ivuavwerhe vwẹ obaro rẹ ọrovwovwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin iso da ta gbe ju vwe yan jen ihwo me evo vwo ke we ekevuovo o da ta kidie me vwe ayen ru ju vwe mre ivuavwerhe vwe obaro re orovwovwe

quarantined_verses.text: Jekọp de rhi te orere ri Shikẹm gberhẹnẹdẹ, rọ otọ ri Kenan, vwẹ idjerhe ra wan ni Padanaram cha, o de mu erhọn phihọ ughere rẹ orere na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jekop de rhi te orere ri shikem gberhenede ro oto ri kenan vwe idjerhe ra wan ni padanaram cha o de mu erhon phiho ughere re orere na

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ ọke nana Dinah rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Leah, ro vwiẹ ki Jekọp da yanran re yere eya rẹ otọ na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana dinah re omote ri leah ro vwie ki jekop da yanran re yere eya re oto na

quarantined_verses.text: Eriyin Jekọp de nyo nẹ e gbe ọmọtẹ rọye Dinah ẹgua; ẹkẹvuọvo yẹ emọ rọye vẹ uchuru na je obo ẹghwa, Jekọp de rhurhu ota na bẹsiẹ rẹ ayen vwọ rhe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: eriyin jekop de nyo ne e gbe omote roye dinah egua ekevuovo ye emo roye ve uchuru na je obo eghwa jekop de rhurhu ota na besie re ayen vwo rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Hamọr rẹ ọsẹ ri Shikẹm de bru Jekọp rhe re vuẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: hamor re ose ri shikem de bru jekop rhe re vue

quarantined_verses.text: Emọ ri Jekọp de nẹ ẹghwa rhe, rẹ ayen vwo nyo ota na; ivun de miovwo emọ na gangan, kidie o ru emu rẹ ẹkpa vwẹ Izrẹl ro vwo nene ọmọtẹ ri Jekọp mroma, kidie a mrẹ emu ọtiọye dẹvo-o.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: emo ri jekop de ne eghwa rhe re ayen vwo nyo ota na ivun de miovwo emo na gangan kidie o ru emu re ekpa vwe izrel ro vwo nene omote ri jekop mroma kidie a mre emu otioye devo o

quarantined_verses.text: Jẹn avwanre rọvwọ kugbe; vwẹ emetẹ wẹn kẹ avwanre, rere wa reyọ emetẹ rẹ avwanre vwọ rọvwọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jen avwanre rovwo kugbe vwe emete wen ke avwanre rere wa reyo emete re avwanre vwo rovwo

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen da ta kẹ ayen nẹ, Avwanre se ru emu nana-a, ma sa vwẹ oniọvo rẹ avwanre kẹ upheruphee, kidie ọyena omaẹphọphọ vwọ kẹ avwanre.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta ke ayen ne avwanre se ru emu nana a ma sa vwe oniovo re avwanre ke upheruphee kidie oyena omaephopho vwo ke avwanre

quarantined_verses.text: Emu ọvuọvo kọye we ru rẹ avwanre ke rhọvwe: kẹ ovwanvwan dia kiri obo rẹ avwanre epha na kọye kọshare kọshare re ovwan ejobi kọ yanvwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: emu ovuovo koye we ru re avwanre ke rhovwe ke ovwanvwan dia kiri obo re avwanre epha na koye koshare koshare re ovwan ejobi ko yanvwe

quarantined_verses.text: Ke Me sa vwẹ emetẹ rẹ avwanre kẹ ovwan, kẹ avwanre je sa rọvwọ e re ovwan, avwanre vẹ ovwan ki yeri kugbe avwanre ejobi ke dia oma ọvo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ke me sa vwe emete re avwanre ke ovwan ke avwanre je sa rovwo e re ovwan avwanre ve ovwan ki yeri kugbe avwanre ejobi ke dia oma ovo

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo wa rha davwerhọ-ọ ru wa da yanvwe-e, kẹ avwanre reyọ ọmọtẹ rẹ avwanre, avwanre ki kpo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo wa rha davwerho o ru wa da yanvwe e ke avwanre reyo omote re avwanre avwanre ki kpo

quarantined_verses.text: Ihwo nana vwenẹ igbeyan rẹ avwanre; e jẹn ayen dia otọ na rẹ ayen cho eki vwọ, gbe nighe, otọ na ọ rhoro rọ sa gba ayen ejobi; e jẹn avwanre reyọ emetẹ rayen vwọ rọvwọ, re ayen je reyọ e re avwanre.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ihwo nana vwene igbeyan re avwanre e jen ayen dia oto na re ayen cho eki vwo gbe nighe oto na o rhoro ro sa gba ayen ejobi e jen avwanre reyo emete rayen vwo rovwo re ayen je reyo e re avwanre

quarantined_verses.text: Jokpa rẹ Ọnana ọvo ọye ayen vẹ avwanre vwọ sa dia kugbe, rere avwanre vẹ ayen sa vwọ dia ihwo ọvo nẹ kọshare kọshare vwẹ uherevie rẹ avwanre kọ yanvwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jokpa re onana ovo oye ayen ve avwanre vwo sa dia kugbe rere avwanre ve ayen sa vwo dia ihwo ovo ne koshare koshare vwe uherevie re avwanre ko yanvwe

quarantined_verses.text: We rhe roro nẹ te uchuru, te eyere kugbe eranvwe rayen ejobi ke dia e re avwanre-e? Takpe avwanre vẹ ayen kuoma gbe, ke ayen nene avwanre dia.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: we rhe roro ne te uchuru te eyere kugbe eranvwe rayen ejobi ke dia e re avwanre e takpe avwanre ve ayen kuoma gbe ke ayen nene avwanre dia

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Jekọp da ta kẹ evwruwevwi rọye kugbe ekru re vẹ ọye gba herọ, Wa kpare ẹdjọ erhorha ri rhe ovwan ejobi kufia, re we phorho oma rẹ ovwan, re we ku iwun rẹ ovwan phihọ otọ,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop da ta ke evwruwevwi roye kugbe ekru re ve oye gba hero wa kpare edjo erhorha ri rhe ovwan ejobi kufia re we phorho oma re ovwan re we ku iwun re ovwan phiho oto

quarantined_verses.text: we jẹn avwanre vrẹn re e kpo Bẹtẹl, re Me dia oboyi so agbada kẹ Ọghẹnẹ ro nyo vwe vwẹ ọke rẹ ukpokpogho, rọ vẹ ovwẹ herọ vwẹ asan kasan Me rare ejobi.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: we jen avwanre vren re e kpo betel re me dia oboyi so agbada ke oghene ro nyo vwe vwe oke re ukpokpogho ro ve ovwe hero vwe asan kasan me rare ejobi

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin ayen da vwẹ ẹdjọ, erhorha rẹ ayen vwori ejobi kẹ Jekọp, kugbe isa rẹ erhọn rẹ ayen ku phihọ, Jekọp de si ayen nu vwẹ otọ rẹ ọhahe rọ kẹrẹ Shikẹm.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da vwe edjo erhorha re ayen vwori ejobi ke jekop kugbe isa re erhon re ayen ku phiho jekop de si ayen nu vwe oto re ohahe ro kere shikem

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ da rhoma vwẹ oma phia kẹ Jekọp, ro vwo nẹ Padanaram cha, ọ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene da rhoma vwe oma phia ke jekop ro vwo ne padanaram cha o da ne erhovwo ke

quarantined_verses.text: Otọ re Me vwọ kẹ Ebraham, kugbe Aizik ke Me je vwẹ ayen kẹ wẹ, ke Me vwẹ otọ na kẹ emọ wẹn re cha vwẹ obuko wẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oto re me vwo ke ebraham kugbe aizik ke me je vwe ayen ke we ke me vwe oto na ke emo wen re cha vwe obuko we

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ ayen vwọ otọ na re Rubẹn de nene Bilhah rẹ aye rẹ ọsẹ rọye mroma; Izrẹl de nyo. Emeshare rẹ Jekọp da dia ihwivẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re ayen vwo oto na re ruben de nene bilhah re aye re ose roye mroma izrel de nyo emeshare re jekop da dia ihwive

quarantined_verses.text: Fikiridie ayen vwo eyere buebu gangan o rhe jẹn ayen yeri kugbee, otọ na sa gba aye-en kidie uchuru rayen bunọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: fikiridie ayen vwo eyere buebu gangan o rhe jen ayen yeri kugbee oto na sa gba aye en kidie uchuru rayen buno

quarantined_verses.text: Kọye Isọ da dia orere rọ enu rẹ ugbenu ri Seir; Isọ na kọye Idọm.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: koye iso da dia orere ro enu re ugbenu ri seir iso na koye idom

quarantined_verses.text: Enana keye uvwiẹ rẹ Isọ ọsẹ rẹ Idọm vwẹ obo orere rẹ ugbenu ri Seir.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: enana keye uvwie re iso ose re idom vwe obo orere re ugbenu ri seir

quarantined_verses.text: Jobab de ghwu, Husham rẹ ohwo rẹ otọ ri Teman da re vwẹ asan ro nuru.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jobab de ghwu husham re ohwo re oto ri teman da re vwe asan ro nuru

quarantined_verses.text: Husham de ghwu, Hadad rẹ ọmọ ri Bedad, ro phi Midian kua vwẹ otọ ri Moab na, da re vwẹ asan ro nuru, odẹ rẹ orere rọye kẹ Avit.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: husham de ghwu hadad re omo ri bedad ro phi midian kua vwe oto ri moab na da re vwe asan ro nuru ode re orere roye ke avit

quarantined_verses.text: Samlah de ghwu, Shaul ri Rehoʼboth rọ dia oma rẹ urhie ri Yufretis da re vwẹ asan ro nuru.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: samlah de ghwu shaul ri reho'both ro dia oma re urhie ri yufretis da re vwe asan ro nuru

quarantined_verses.text: Shaul de ghwu, Baal-hanan rẹ ọmọ rẹ Akbor da re vwe asan ro nuru.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: shaul de ghwu baal hanan re omo re akbor da re vwe asan ro nuru

quarantined_verses.text: Ohwo na da ta, Ayen yanran re, kidie mi nyori rẹ ayen vwọ tanẹ, E je kpo Dotan. Etiyin Josẹf de bresi rẹ imoni rọye, ọ da rhe mrẹ ayen vwi Dotan.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ohwo na da ta ayen yanran re kidie mi nyori re ayen vwo tane e je kpo dotan etiyin josef de bresi re imoni roye o da rhe mre ayen vwi dotan

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen da kparo mrẹ vwẹ ogboko, ro ji te ayen omaa na, ayen da ghwa jẹn iroro kpahọ obo rẹ ayen ru hwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen da kparo mre vwe ogboko ro ji te ayen omaa na ayen da ghwa jen iroro kpaho obo re ayen ru hwe

quarantined_verses.text: Rubẹn da ta kẹ ayen, Wo sun ọbara te otọ-ọ, muo phihọ ọgọdọ nana vwẹ etinẹ vwẹ evun rẹ ẹghwa na, ẹkẹvuọvo wa vwẹ obo te-e - rere ọ vwọ mrẹ asan reyọ mie ayen vwo rhe ọsẹ rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ruben da ta ke ayen wo sun obara te oto o muo phiho ogodo nana vwe etine vwe evun re eghwa na ekevuovo wa vwe obo te e rere o vwo mre asan reyo mie ayen vwo rhe ose roye

quarantined_verses.text: Kọye ri Josẹf rhi vwo te asan rẹ imoni rọye epha re, ayen da ghwiẹ ewun no oma, ewun rọye rẹ ogrogro ro te abọ re na ro ku phihọ na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: koye ri josef rhi vwo te asan re imoni roye epha re ayen da ghwie ewun no oma ewun roye re ogrogro ro te abo re na ro ku phiho na

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen tidia te otọ kẹ ayen ria emu, ayen vwọ kpare opharo ayen da mrẹ usun rẹ ihwo rẹ Ishmael ri nẹ Giliad cha, vẹ usun rẹ iyesi rayen re ghwa orhọrhe, adjija, kugbe egẹ, re yanran kpo Ijipt.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen tidia te oto ke ayen ria emu ayen vwo kpare opharo ayen da mre usun re ihwo re ishmael ri ne giliad cha ve usun re iyesi rayen re ghwa orhorhe adjija kugbe ege re yanran kpo ijipt

quarantined_verses.text: Yanrhe, ra shẹ kẹ ihwo rẹ Ishmael, e jẹ obọ rẹ avwanre dia enu rọye-e, kidie omoni rẹ avwanre, uvwo rẹ avwanre. Ayen da reyọ ota rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: yanrhe ra she ke ihwo re ishmael e je obo re avwanre dia enu roye e kidie omoni re avwanre uvwo re avwanre ayen da reyo ota roye

quarantined_verses.text: Usun rẹ ihwo ri Midian ke wan vrẹn, ayen de si Josẹf nẹ ọgọdọ na rhe, ayen da she kẹ Ishmael ovwavwọn ri shẹkẹl rẹ idọnọ uje, ayen da reyọ kpo Ijipt.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: usun re ihwo ri midian ke wan vren ayen de si josef ne ogodo na rhe ayen da she ke ishmael ovwavwon ri shekel re idono uje ayen da reyo kpo ijipt

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke ri Rubẹn vwo rhivwi rhe asan ọgọdọ na rọ rha mrẹ Josẹf vwẹ etiyi-in, ọ da bẹre emwa rọye
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke ri ruben vwo rhivwi rhe asan ogodo na ro rha mre josef vwe etiyi in o da bere emwa roye

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da rhoma vwiẹ ọshare ọfa, o de se odẹ rọye Shelah. Chezib ọ epha ọke ro vwo vwiẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da rhoma vwie oshare ofa o de se ode roye shelah chezib o epha oke ro vwo vwie

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ẹr rẹ ọwanra ri Juda, da dia ohwo umwemwu vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo; Ọrovwohwo de hwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo er re owanra ri juda da dia ohwo umwemwu vwe obaro re orovwohwo orovwohwo de hwe

quarantined_verses.text: Obo ro ruru na da bra vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo, Etiyin ọ da je teyọ hwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: obo ro ruru na da bra vwe obaro re orovwohwo etiyin o da je teyo hwe

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Juda da ta kẹ aye re ọmọ rọye na Tamar ne, Gba dia ayeuku vwẹ uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ wẹn bẹsiẹ ri Shelah rẹ ọmọ mẹ vwọ ghwanre - kidie oshọ muro nẹ o de rhe ghwu ọboba kiri iniọvo rọye. Kọye Tamar da ra dia uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin juda da ta ke aye re omo roye na tamar ne gba dia ayeuku vwe uwevwi re ose wen besie ri shelah re omo me vwo ghwanre kidie osho muro ne o de rhe ghwu oboba kiri iniovo roye koye tamar da ra dia uwevwi re ose roye

quarantined_verses.text: ọ da ghwiẹ iwun rẹ uvweri rọye nu, ọ da vwẹ oga vwo rhurhu, ọ da vwẹ emwa kroma, o de tidia unu rẹ egodo rọ Enaim rọ idjerhe ra wan kpo Timnah, kidie ọ mrẹre nẹ Shelah ghwaire, yẹ a je vwẹ ọye kẹ vwọ rọvwọ-ọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da ghwie iwun re uvweri roye nu o da vwe oga vwo rhurhu o da vwe emwa kroma o de tidia unu re egodo ro enaim ro idjerhe ra wan kpo timnah kidie o mrere ne shelah ghwaire ye a je vwe oye ke vwo rovwo o

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke ri Juda vwọ mrẹ o de vwo roro igberadja, kidie ọ vwẹ oga rhurhu opharo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke ri juda vwo mre o de vwo roro igberadja kidie o vwe oga rhurhu opharo

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ uvwiẹ rọye rhi vwo te, agbava kọye evun rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re uvwie roye rhi vwo te agbava koye evun roye

quarantined_verses.text: Rọ vwọ chuẹ uvwiẹ re, ọvo da vwẹ obọ rhe, orhere na de churu isene muo obọ, tanẹ, Ona re ka rhe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ro vwo chue uvwie re ovo da vwe obo rhe orhere na de churu isene muo obo tane ona re ka rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Kọye ọ da vwẹ aruesiri vwo ni Josẹf ọ da vwẹ ẹro te, o de vwo mu osun rẹ uwevwi rọye kugbe emu ro vwori ejobi.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: koye o da vwe aruesiri vwo ni josef o da vwe ero te o de vwo mu osun re uwevwi roye kugbe emu ro vwori ejobi

quarantined_verses.text: Ghwe ne ọke re vwo mu osun rẹ uwevwi rọye kugbe obo ro vwori ejobi, Ọrovwohwo de bruphihọ uwevwi rẹ ohwo rẹ Ijipt na fiki ri Josẹf, ebruphihọ rẹ Ọrovwohwo da enu rẹ emu ro vwori ejobi, te uwevwi te ẹghwa.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ghwe ne oke re vwo mu osun re uwevwi roye kugbe obo ro vwori ejobi orovwohwo de bruphiho uwevwi re ohwo re ijipt na fiki ri josef ebruphiho re orovwohwo da enu re emu ro vwori ejobi te uwevwi te eghwa

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo ẹdẹ ọvo, ri Josẹf vwọ ro uwevwi re ru iruo re jẹn ohwo ọvuọvo uwevwi-i.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ede ovo ri josef vwo ro uwevwi re ru iruo re jen ohwo ovuovo uwevwi i

quarantined_verses.text: o de se ihwo rẹ uwevwi na rhe ọ da ta kẹ ayen, No, ọshare mẹ reyọ ohwo ri Hibru rhe ohri rẹ avwanre re ọ rhe phọphọ avwanre; o de bru vwe rhe ri sherhẹ, Mi de kperi gangan,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o de se ihwo re uwevwi na rhe o da ta ke ayen no oshare me reyo ohwo ri hibru rhe ohri re avwanre re o rhe phopho avwanre o de bru vwe rhe ri sherhe mi de kperi gangan

quarantined_verses.text: o de gbe ikun ọvuọvo na kẹ tanẹ, Odibo rẹ ohwo ri Hibru ru wọ reyọ rhe ohri rẹ avwanre, o de bru vwe rhe re phọphọ ovwẹ;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o de gbe ikun ovuovo na ke tane odibo re ohwo ri hibru ru wo reyo rhe ohri re avwanre o de bru vwe rhe re phopho ovwe

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ọrovwohwo vi Josẹf herọ ivun rọye da vwerhọ, ọ da vwẹ aruesiri kẹ vwẹ obaro rẹ olori rẹ uwodi na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo orovwohwo vi josef hero ivun roye da vwerho o da vwe aruesiri ke vwe obaro re olori re uwodi na

quarantined_verses.text: Olori rẹ uwodi na rha davwerhọ rẹ obo ra vwọ kẹ Josẹf yọnre na-a, kidie Ọrovwohwo vọye herọ; kemu kemu ro ruru ejobi, Ọrovwohwo da nẹrhẹ oyovwi.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: olori re uwodi na rha davwerho re obo ra vwo ke josef yonre na a kidie orovwohwo voye hero kemu kemu ro ruru ejobi orovwohwo da nerhe oyovwi

quarantined_verses.text: Onotu rẹ idugbu na da vwẹ ayen kẹ Josẹf, kọye vwẹ ẹro te ayen; ayen da rhe dia uwodi na emerha.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: onotu re idugbu na da vwe ayen ke josef koye vwe ero te ayen ayen da rhe dia uwodi na emerha

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da nọ inotu ri Fero na re mu phihọ uwodi vwẹ uwevwi rẹ onini rọye na, Die nẹrhẹ ovwan muomahọ nonẹ?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da no inotu ri fero na re mu phiho uwodi vwe uwevwi re onini roye na die nerhe ovwan muomaho none

quarantined_verses.text: Kidie vwẹ uyota e cho vwe nẹ otọ ri Hibru rhe; vwẹ obonẹ na mi ji ru emu rọ chọre re vwo mu vwe phihọ evun rẹ ẹmwa na-a.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: kidie vwe uyota e cho vwe ne oto ri hibru rhe vwe obone na mi ji ru emu ro chore re vwo mu vwe phiho evun re emwa na a

quarantined_verses.text: vwẹ evun rẹ ẹdẹ rẹ erha na Fero kọ kpare uyovwi wẹn nu we oma; ko churu we si urhe; ephran ke cha sohrọ uvwo wẹn re.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe evun re ede re erha na fero ko kpare uyovwi wen nu we oma ko churu we si urhe ephran ke cha sohro uvwo wen re

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ ikpe ivẹ soso vwọ wan nu, Fero da vwerhẹ evwerhẹ nẹ ọye de mudia orhoma rọ urhie ri Nile,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re ikpe ive soso vwo wan nu fero da vwerhe evwerhe ne oye de mudia orhoma ro urhie ri nile

quarantined_verses.text: o vwo ni, irhuẹn ighwrẹ sọkọ sọkọ tubie tubie de nẹ evun rẹ urhie na rhe, kẹ ayen ria ẹgo rẹ oma rẹ urhie na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o vwo ni irhuen ighwre soko soko tubie tubie de ne evun re urhie na rhe ke ayen ria ego re oma re urhie na

quarantined_verses.text: O rhe vwo ni, irhuẹn ighwrẹ efa dọndọn grosi da vwọ kpahe ayen nẹ evun rẹ urhie na rhe, ayen de mudia kẹrẹ irhuẹn ri chekọ na vwẹ orhoma rẹ urhie na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o rhe vwo ni irhuen ighwre efa dondon grosi da vwo kpahe ayen ne evun re urhie na rhe ayen de mudia kere irhuen ri cheko na vwe orhoma re urhie na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ivun vwo miovwo Fero kpahe idibo rọye, ro vwo mu vwe vẹ onotu rẹ ọkakemu phihọ uwodi vwẹ obo uwevwi rẹ onotu rẹ idugbu na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ivun vwo miovwo fero kpahe idibo roye ro vwo mu vwe ve onotu re okakemu phiho uwodi vwe obo uwevwi re onotu re idugbu na

quarantined_verses.text: Emeghene ri Hibru rọ vẹ avwanre gba Etiyin na, odibo rẹ onotu rẹ idugbu na; ọke rẹ avwanre vwọ ta evwerhẹ na kẹ re, ọ da fan otọ rẹ evwerhẹ na kẹ avwanre, dohwo dotọ rọye kirobo rẹ evwerhẹ na epha.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: emeghene ri hibru ro ve avwanre gba etiyin na odibo re onotu re idugbu na oke re avwanre vwo ta evwerhe na ke re o da fan oto re evwerhe na ke avwanre dohwo doto roye kirobo re evwerhe na epha

quarantined_verses.text: Kirobo rọ fan otọ rẹ evwerhẹ na kẹ avwanre te eriyin ọ wanre; a rhoma reyọ ovwẹ vwo kpo ako re iruo mẹ, onotu rẹ ọkakemu na e de churo si.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: kirobo ro fan oto re evwerhe na ke avwanre te eriyin o wanre a rhoma reyo ovwe vwo kpo ako re iruo me onotu re okakemu na e de churo si

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Nighe, vwẹ evun rẹ evwerhẹ mẹ mi de mudia vwẹ orhoma rẹ urhie ri Nile,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin fero da ta ki josef nighe vwe evun re evwerhe me mi de mudia vwe orhoma re urhie ri nile

quarantined_verses.text: irhuẹn ighwrẹ efa dọndọn grosi, da vwọ kpahe ayen nẹ evun rẹ urhie na rhe, Me je mrẹ oghẹre tiọna vwẹ Ijipt na dẹvo-o.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: irhuen ighwre efa dondon grosi da vwo kpahe ayen ne evun re urhie na rhe me je mre oghere tiona vwe ijipt na devo o

quarantined_verses.text: ẹkẹvuọvo rẹ ayen vwọ rọ ayen nu ohwo ọvuọvo sa riẹn nẹ ayen rọ aye-en, kidie ayen je pha dọndọn kirobo rẹ ayen epha jovwo. Kọye mi de gbunie rhe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo re ayen vwo ro ayen nu ohwo ovuovo sa rien ne ayen ro aye en kidie ayen je pha dondon kirobo re ayen epha jovwo koye mi de gbunie rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Me da je mrẹ vwẹ evun rẹ evwerhẹ mẹ na, eduru re eka ighwrẹ re djẹ rhe vwẹ ugbẹ ọvo, gbuke yoyovwi;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: me da je mre vwe evun re evwerhe me na eduru re eka ighwre re dje rhe vwe ugbe ovo gbuke yoyovwi

quarantined_verses.text: Rere a sẹro rẹ emu na koko vwọ hẹrhẹ ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ owẹvwe ro che fi vwẹ Ijipt na, rere owẹvwe vwo jẹn ihwo na ehwe ghwẹ vwe evun rẹ otọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: rere a sero re emu na koko vwo herhe ikpe ighwre re owevwe ro che fi vwe ijipt na rere owevwe vwo jen ihwo na ehwe ghwe vwe evun re oto na

quarantined_verses.text: Fero da ta kẹ idibo rọye nẹ, Ke avwanre sa mrẹ ohwo ọtiọnana, re erhi rẹ Ọghẹnẹ rheri?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: fero da ta ke idibo roye ne ke avwanre sa mre ohwo otionana re erhi re oghene rheri

quarantined_verses.text: Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Nighe, Me vwẹ owẹ mu osun vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: fero da ta ki josef nighe me vwe owe mu osun vwe oto re ijipt

quarantined_verses.text: Ọfa, Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Mẹvwẹ Fero, ẹkẹvuọvo wọ rha rhọvwe-e ohwo ọvuọvo rha sa kpare obọ eye owọ vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt na-a.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ofa fero da ta ki josef mevwe fero ekevuovo wo rha rhovwe e ohwo ovuovo rha sa kpare obo eye owo vwe oto re ijipt na a

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo Jekọp gbi ji Bẹnjamin rẹ oniọvo ri Josẹf nene aye-en, fiki rẹ oshọ rẹ emu de rhe ruo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo jekop gbi ji benjamin re oniovo ri josef nene aye en fiki re osho re emu de rhe ruo

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ ọke nana Josẹf kọye osun rẹ otọ na ejobi; ọye je ohwo rọ shẹ kẹ ihwo rẹ otọ na ejobi. Emesẹ ri Josẹf na da rhe, ayen de diguẹ bọvwọ epharo rhu otọ vwọ kẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana josef koye osun re oto na ejobi oye je ohwo ro she ke ihwo re oto na ejobi emese ri josef na da rhe ayen de digue bovwo epharo rhu oto vwo ke

quarantined_verses.text: Avwanre ejobi emọ rẹ ọshare ọvo, avwanre ihwo dẹdẹn, idibo wẹn dia igborhugborho-o.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: avwanre ejobi emo re oshare ovo avwanre ihwo deden idibo wen dia igborhugborho o

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo Josẹf da ta kẹ ayen, O pha kirobo re Me ta kẹ ovwan na, ovwan ogborhugborho.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo josef da ta ke ayen o pha kirobo re me ta ke ovwan na ovwan ogborhugborho

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ Ọnana kọye Me vwọ davwe ovwan ni: vwẹ ogangan ri Fero, ovwan che kpo nẹ etinẹ-ẹ jokpa nẹ ovwan reyọ omoni rẹ ovwan rẹ otete ejobi na rhe etinẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe onana koye me vwo davwe ovwan ni vwe ogangan ri fero ovwan che kpo ne etine e jokpa ne ovwan reyo omoni re ovwan re otete ejobi na rhe etine

quarantined_verses.text: We ji ohwo ọvo vwẹ usun rẹ ovwan, rere ọ ra reyọ omoni rẹ ovwan na rhe, jẹn ovwan ri chekọ uwodi, kọna e vwo vughe uyota rẹ ovwan, sẹ ovwan ghine ihwo uyota, ọ rha dia ọtiọye-e, vwẹ ogangan ri Fero, o muẹro nẹ ogborhugborho ovwan ruẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: we ji ohwo ovo vwe usun re ovwan rere o ra reyo omoni re ovwan na rhe jen ovwan ri cheko uwodi kona e vwo vughe uyota re ovwan se ovwan ghine ihwo uyota o rha dia otioye e vwe ogangan ri fero o muero ne ogborhugborho ovwan rue

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ erha Josẹf da ta kẹ ayen, Ru Ọnana re ovwan rhọ, kidie Me djẹ oshọ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ:
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe ede re erha josef da ta ke ayen ru onana re ovwan rho kidie me dje osho re oghene
