quarantined_verses.text: ọ da dianẹ ovwan ghine ihwo rẹ uyota, we gbe jẹn ọvo vwẹ usun rẹ imoni rẹ ovwan na vwo vwẹ uwodi na, rere iri chekọ kpo re ayen ghwa eka rhe ekru rẹ ovwan rẹ owẹvwe hwe vwẹ obo uwevwi,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da diane ovwan ghine ihwo re uyota we gbe jen ovo vwe usun re imoni re ovwan na vwo vwe uwodi na rere iri cheko kpo re ayen ghwa eka rhe ekru re ovwan re owevwe hwe vwe obo uwevwi

quarantined_verses.text: re wa reyọ oniọvo rẹ ovwan rẹ otete na rhe vwe; kọye ota rẹ ovwan vwo muẹro, we gbi rhe ghwu-u. Ayen de ru ọtiọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re wa reyo oniovo re ovwan re otete na rhe vwe koye ota re ovwan vwo muero we gbi rhe ghwu u ayen de ru otioye

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin ayen da ta kẹ ohwohwo, Vwẹ ọrẹ uyota, avwanre riabe rẹ ọmọsẹ rẹ avwanre na, kidie avwanre mrẹ uvwerhe rẹ udu rọye, ọke rọ vwọ rẹ, avwanre kerhọ-ọ, fiki rẹ ọtiọye na ihri rẹ eku rọ viẹre na kọye a na mie avwanre na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da ta ke ohwohwo vwe ore uyota avwanre riabe re omose re avwanre na kidie avwanre mre uvwerhe re udu roye oke ro vwo re avwanre kerho o fiki re otioye na ihri re eku ro viere na koye a na mie avwanre na

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen rha riẹn ni Josẹf nyo obo rẹ ayen ta na-a, kidie tanumeta uvwre rayen.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen rha rien ni josef nyo obo re ayen ta na a kidie tanumeta uvwre rayen

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen de kru eghwa rẹ eka nyẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rayen, ayen da yanran.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen de kru eghwa re eka nye eketekete rayen ayen da yanran

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ ọvo vwọ rhan unu rẹ ebo rọye re ọ vwẹ emu kẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rọye vwẹ asan re de muerhọ, ọ da mrẹ igho rọye vwẹ unu rẹ ebo rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re ovo vwo rhan unu re ebo roye re o vwe emu ke eketekete roye vwe asan re de muerho o da mre igho roye vwe unu re ebo roye

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ayen rhi vwo te uwevwi ra vwa ọsẹ rayen Jekọp vwẹ otọ ri Kenan, ayen de gbe ikun rẹ obo re phia kẹ ayen ejobi kẹ, tanẹ,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ayen rhi vwo te uwevwi ra vwa ose rayen jekop vwe oto ri kenan ayen de gbe ikun re obo re phia ke ayen ejobi ke tane

quarantined_verses.text: Ohwo na, ọrovwori rẹ otọ na, ọ ta ota gbaegbae vwọ kẹ avwanre, ọ da vwẹ avwanre roro igborhugborho re rhe mrẹ ẹba rẹ otọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ohwo na orovwori re oto na o ta ota gbaegbae vwo ke avwanre o da vwe avwanre roro igborhugborho re rhe mre eba re oto na

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo avwanre da ta kẹ, Avwanre ihwo rẹ uyota, avwanre dia igborhugborho-o;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo avwanre da ta ke avwanre ihwo re uyota avwanre dia igborhugborho o

quarantined_verses.text: avwanre emesẹ ihwivẹ, emọ rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre, ọvo gbe herọ-ọ ọrẹ otete vẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre obo otọ ri Kenan nonẹ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: avwanre emese ihwive emo re ose re avwanre ovo gbe hero o ore otete ve ose re avwanre obo oto ri kenan none na

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin ohwo na, ọrovwori rẹ otọ na, da ta kẹ avwanre, Ọnana kọye Me vwọ riẹn nẹ ovwan omamọ rẹ ihwo rẹ uyota; wan yan jẹn ọvo rẹ emesẹ rẹ ovwan na vwo kẹ vwẹ, re wa reyọ eka rhe ekru rẹ ovwan rẹ owẹvwe hwe, re wa yanran.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin ohwo na orovwori re oto na da ta ke avwanre onana koye me vwo rien ne ovwan omamo re ihwo re uyota wan yan jen ovo re emese re ovwan na vwo ke vwe re wa reyo eka rhe ekru re ovwan re owevwe hwe re wa yanran

quarantined_verses.text: Reyọ omoni rẹ ovwan rẹ otete na rhe vwe, ke Me mrẹ vughe nẹ ovwan dia igborhugborho ẹkẹvuọvo ihwo rẹ uyota we ruẹ, ki mi siobọ nẹ ọmọsẹ rẹ ovwan, ku wa cho eki vwẹ otọ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: reyo omoni re ovwan re otete na rhe vwe ke me mre vughe ne ovwan dia igborhugborho ekevuovo ihwo re uyota we rue ki mi siobo ne omose re ovwan ku wa cho eki vwe oto na

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ ayen vwo ku eghwa nẹ ebo na, nighe dohwo dọko rẹ igho rọye evun rẹ ebo rọye, te ayen te ọsẹ rayen vwọ mrẹ ọko rẹ igho rayen o de gbe ayen unu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re ayen vwo ku eghwa ne ebo na nighe dohwo doko re igho roye evun re ebo roye te ayen te ose rayen vwo mre oko re igho rayen o de gbe ayen unu

quarantined_verses.text: Vwẹ ọke nana owẹvwe na rhi fi gangan vwẹ otọ na re.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana owevwe na rhi fi gangan vwe oto na re

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ ayen rha vwọ re emu rẹ ayen dẹ nẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt rhe re nu, ọsẹ rayen da ta kẹ ayen, Wa rhoma yanran, ra de ememu rhe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re ayen rha vwo re emu re ayen de ne oto re ijipt rhe re nu ose rayen da ta ke ayen wa rhoma yanran ra de ememu rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Wo de siobọ nẹ ọmọ na kẹ avwanre, avwanre ke ra ra dẹ emu rhe we,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: wo de siobo ne omo na ke avwanre avwanre ke ra ra de emu rhe we

quarantined_verses.text: ẹkẹvuọvo wo rhe siobọ no kẹ avwanre-e, avwanre rha sa ra-a, kidie ohwo na ta kẹ avwanre gbagba nẹ, Wo sa mrẹ opharo mẹ-ẹ, jopka nẹ ọmọsẹ wẹn na nene uwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo wo rhe siobo no ke avwanre e avwanre rha sa ra a kidie ohwo na ta ke avwanre gbagba ne wo sa mre opharo me e jopka ne omose wen na nene uwe

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen da kpahe, Ohwo na jomaotọ no avwanre ekpẹn rẹ uvwiẹ rẹ avwanre, tanẹ, Ọsẹ wẹn je akpọ? We ji vwo omoni ọfa? Obo rẹ avwanre ta kẹ na eye obobo rọ nọ avwanre, kẹ avwanre rha riẹn nẹ ọ cha tanẹ, Reyọ ọmọsẹ wẹn rhe?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen da kpahe ohwo na jomaoto no avwanre ekpen re uvwie re avwanre tane ose wen je akpo we ji vwo omoni ofa obo re avwanre ta ke na eye obobo ro no avwanre ke avwanre rha rien ne o cha tane reyo omose wen rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Juda da ta kẹ Izrẹl rẹ ọsẹ rọye, Ji ọmọ na nene uvwe, ke avwanre vrẹn yanran, avwanre ke rhọ Me gbi ghwu-u, te avwanre te emọ rẹ avwanre.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: juda da ta ke izrel re ose roye ji omo na nene uvwe ke avwanre vren yanran avwanre ke rho me gbi ghwu u te avwanre te emo re avwanre

quarantined_verses.text: ọ dianẹ ke Me gbe eghẹrẹ-ẹ, mane avwanre rhe rhivwi rhe asiava re.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o diane ke me gbe eghere e mane avwanre rhe rhivwi rhe asiava re

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin ọsẹ rayen Izrẹl da ta kẹ ayen, ọ da dia ọtiọye, gbe ru ọna: gba sanọ ibi rẹ emamọ esiri rẹ otọ na ẹvo phihọ ekpo, ra phare ọko rhe ohwo na, imi shani vẹ ọnyọ, urho, adjija, ibi ri pistachio, kugbe orhomrẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin ose rayen izrel da ta ke ayen o da dia otioye gbe ru ona gba sano ibi re emamo esiri re oto na evo phiho ekpo ra phare oko rhe ohwo na imi shani ve onyo urho adjija ibi ri pistachio kugbe orhomre

quarantined_verses.text: Wa reyọ ọmọsẹ rẹ ovwan na, we vrẹn, wa rhoma bru ohwo na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: wa reyo omose re ovwan na we vren wa rhoma bru ohwo na

quarantined_verses.text: E jẹn Ọghẹnẹ ro vwo Ẹgba kẹ ovwan aruẹdọn vwẹ obaro rẹ ohwo na, rere o siobọ nẹ ọmọsẹ wẹn ro chekọ vi Bẹnjamin rhe. Ọ da dianẹ emu ru emọ Me nana ivẹ na, ye okpemu ri ru vwe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: e jen oghene ro vwo egba ke ovwan aruedon vwe obaro re ohwo na rere o siobo ne omose wen ro cheko vi benjamin rhe o da diane emu ru emo me nana ive na ye okpemu ri ru vwe

quarantined_verses.text: Oshọ de mu ihwo na fiki robo ra vwọ reyọ ayen rhe obo uwevwi ri Josẹf, ayen da ta, Fiki rẹ igho na, ra rhoma kru phihọ ibo kẹ avwanre dẹvo na, ọye a vwọ reyọ avwanre rhe uwevwi na, rere ayen guọnọ obo rẹ ayen ru mu avwanre, re ayen vwẹ avwanre ru eviẹn re ayen mrasa gborho ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ avwanre.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: osho de mu ihwo na fiki robo ra vwo reyo ayen rhe obo uwevwi ri josef ayen da ta fiki re igho na ra rhoma kru phiho ibo ke avwanre devo na oye a vwo reyo avwanre rhe uwevwi na rere ayen guono obo re ayen ru mu avwanre re ayen vwe avwanre ru evien re ayen mrasa gborho eketekete re avwanre

quarantined_verses.text: Kọye ayen da yan bru omuemu rẹ uwevwi ri Josẹf na, ayen de nene ta ota vwẹ anurhoro rẹ uwevwi na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: koye ayen da yan bru omuemu re uwevwi ri josef na ayen de nene ta ota vwe anurhoro re uwevwi na

quarantined_verses.text: ayen da ta, E ọrovwovwe, avwanre rhere vwẹ obọ rẹ ẹsosuọ re dẹ emu;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta e orovwovwe avwanre rhere vwe obo re esosuo re de emu

quarantined_verses.text: rẹ avwanre rhi vwo te asan re de muerhọ avwanre da rhan ibo rẹ avwanre, Me vwo ni, ma da rhoma mrẹ ọko rẹ igho rẹ avwanre na vwẹ unu rẹ ibo na, e gbare dẹn kirobo re epha jovwo; kọye avwanre da rhoma ghwa ayen rhe,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re avwanre rhi vwo te asan re de muerho avwanre da rhan ibo re avwanre me vwo ni ma da rhoma mre oko re igho re avwanre na vwe unu re ibo na e gbare den kirobo re epha jovwo koye avwanre da rhoma ghwa ayen rhe

quarantined_verses.text: avwanre je ghwa igho efa boma rhe re ma cha vwọ dẹ emu. Avwanre rha riẹn ohwo ro phi igho na phihọ ibo rẹ avwanre-e.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: avwanre je ghwa igho efa boma rhe re ma cha vwo de emu avwanre rha rien ohwo ro phi igho na phiho ibo re avwanre e

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ohwo na vwọ vwẹ ayen te uwevwi ri Josẹf, ọ da vwẹ ame kẹ ayen, ayen da hworhẹ awọ rayen, ọke rha vwẹ emu kẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rayen re,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ohwo na vwo vwe ayen te uwevwi ri josef o da vwe ame ke ayen ayen da hworhe awo rayen oke rha vwe emu ke eketekete rayen re

quarantined_verses.text: Ri Josẹf vwo te uwevwi re, ayen da reyọ ọko na rẹ ayen phare rhe na vwọ kẹ, ayen de diguẹ te otọ kẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ri josef vwo te uwevwi re ayen da reyo oko na re ayen phare rhe na vwo ke ayen de digue te oto ke

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da kpare opharo ọ da mrẹ oniọvo rọye Bẹnjamin, ọmọ rẹ oni rọye, ọ da ta, Ọnana ọmọsẹ rẹ ovwan rẹ otete na, rẹ ovwan ta kẹ vwẹ na? Ọghẹnẹ ni arodọvwẹ wẹ, ọmọ mẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da kpare opharo o da mre oniovo roye benjamin omo re oni roye o da ta onana omose re ovwan re otete na re ovwan ta ke vwe na oghene ni arodovwe we omo me

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin ọ da vuẹ omuemu rẹ uwevwi rọye nẹ, Kru emu vọn ibo rẹ ihwo na, uche oghwa rẹ ayen sa ghwa, kru igho rẹ ohwo ọvuọvo phihọ ebo rọye,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin o da vue omuemu re uwevwi roye ne kru emu von ibo re ihwo na uche oghwa re ayen sa ghwa kru igho re ohwo ovuovo phiho ebo roye

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ ọke ghwe vwo rhie nu, ihwo na ghwe krẹn te ayen te ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rayen ghwe vrẹn kọye oyan.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re oke ghwe vwo rhie nu ihwo na ghwe kren te ayen te eketekete rayen ghwe vren koye oyan

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ayen je ghwa yan sheri nẹ orere na-a, Josẹf de se omuemu rọye, Vrẹn vwọ tua ihwo na; wọ da djẹ mu ayen, ta kẹ ayen, Die wa vwọ vwẹ umwemwu hwosa rẹ ẹse mẹ kẹ vwẹ?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ayen je ghwa yan sheri ne orere na a josef de se omuemu roye vren vwo tua ihwo na wo da dje mu ayen ta ke ayen die wa vwo vwe umwemwu hwosa re ese me ke vwe

quarantined_verses.text: Nighere, igho rẹ avwanre mrẹre vwe unu rẹ ibo na dẹvo ma rhoma ghwa ayen nẹ otọ ri Kenan rhe, komavọ avwanre vwo cho idọnọ eyẹ oro vwẹ uwevwi rẹ ọrovwovwe?
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: nighere igho re avwanre mrere vwe unu re ibo na devo ma rhoma ghwa ayen ne oto ri kenan rhe komavo avwanre vwo cho idono eye oro vwe uwevwi re orovwovwe

quarantined_verses.text: ọ da hiẹ ayen ọvuọvo, nẹ ọkpako rhiri rẹ te omotete, ọ da mrẹ uko na vwe ebo ri Bẹnjamin.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da hie ayen ovuovo ne okpako rhiri re te omotete o da mre uko na vwe ebo ri benjamin

quarantined_verses.text: Juda da ta, Kidie avwanre cha ta kẹ ọrovwovwe? Die avwanre mrẹ ta? Eyẹ komavọ avwanre se si oma rẹ avwanre no? Ọghẹnẹ guọnọ otọ rẹ abe rẹ idibo wẹn mrẹ nure; nighe, avwanre ke dia eviẹn rẹ ọrovwovwe, te avwanre te ekpuyovwi re ohwo ra mrẹ uko na vwẹ obọ rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: juda da ta kidie avwanre cha ta ke orovwovwe die avwanre mre ta eye komavo avwanre se si oma re avwanre no oghene guono oto re abe re idibo wen mre nure nighe avwanre ke dia evien re orovwovwe te avwanre te ekpuyovwi re ohwo ra mre uko na vwe obo roye

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin wọ da ta kẹ idibo wẹn, Reyọ vwo rhe vwe, rere Me. mrẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin wo da ta ke idibo wen reyo vwo rhe vwe rere me mre

quarantined_verses.text: Avwanre da ta kẹ ọrovwovwe, Ọmọ na sa yan je ọsẹ rọye vwo-o, kidie ọ da yan je ọsẹ rọye vwo, ọsẹ na ko ghwu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: avwanre da ta ke orovwovwe omo na sa yan je ose roye vwo o kidie o da yan je ose roye vwo ose na ko ghwu

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ọsẹ rẹ avwanre vwọ tanẹ, Rhoma ra, wọ ra dẹ ememu rhe avwanre,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ose re avwanre vwo tane rhoma ra wo ra de ememu rhe avwanre

quarantined_verses.text: avwanre da ta, Avwanre sa ra-a. Ọ da dianẹ ọmọsẹ rẹ avwanre rẹ otete na de nene avwanre ra, avwanre ke ra; kidie avwanre sa mrẹ opharo rẹ ohwo na ọfa-a jokpa nẹ ọmọsẹ rẹ ovwan rẹ otete na nene ovwan.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: avwanre da ta avwanre sa ra a o da diane omose re avwanre re otete na de nene avwanre ra avwanre ke ra kidie avwanre sa mre opharo re ohwo na ofa a jokpa ne omose re ovwan re otete na nene ovwan

quarantined_verses.text: Kọye, ọke ri mi vwo te asan rẹ odibo wẹn ọsẹ mẹ, ọmọ na gbi nene avwanre, kirobo rọ vwẹ akpọ kpahọ na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: koye oke ri mi vwo te asan re odibo wen ose me omo na gbi nene avwanre kirobo ro vwe akpo kpaho na

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Josẹf gbi se chiri oma rọye vwẹ irharo rẹ ihwo ri mudia kẹrẹ-ẹ; ọ da van, E ji kohwo kohwo bi nu vwe oma. Ọtiọye na ohwo ọvuọvo rhe mudia kẹrẹ Josẹf ọke rọ vwọ vwẹ oma phia kẹ emesẹ rọye-e.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef gbi se chiri oma roye vwe irharo re ihwo ri mudia kere e o da van e ji kohwo kohwo bi nu vwe oma otioye na ohwo ovuovo rhe mudia kere josef oke ro vwo vwe oma phia ke emese roye e

quarantined_verses.text: O da viẹ phia, ihwo rẹ Ijipt na de nyo, ekru ri Fero ejobi de ji nyo.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da vie phia ihwo re ijipt na de nyo ekru ri fero ejobi de ji nyo

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Josẹf da ta kẹ emesẹ rọye, We si kẹrẹ ovwẹ, Me rẹ ovwan. Ayen de si kẹrẹ. Ọ da ta, Mẹvwẹ Josẹf rẹ ọmọsẹ rẹ ovwan, rẹ ovwan shẹ kpo Ijipt.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef da ta ke emese roye we si kere ovwe me re ovwan ayen de si kere o da ta mevwe josef re omose re ovwan re ovwan she kpo ijipt

quarantined_verses.text: We jẹn oma ro ovwa-an, eyẹ we jẹn ivun rẹ oma rẹ ovwan miovwo ovwa-an, fikiridie wa shẹ vwẹ rhe obonẹ, kidie Ọghẹnẹ ji vwe ka obaro re vwo sivwi arhọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: we jen oma ro ovwa an eye we jen ivun re oma re ovwan miovwo ovwa an fikiridie wa she vwe rhe obone kidie oghene ji vwe ka obaro re vwo sivwi arho

quarantined_verses.text: Ọghẹnẹ ko ji vwe ka obaro rere e vwo sivwi umuku rẹ ihwo vwẹ akpọ na, rere ihwo rẹ ovwan buebu vwọ sa rhọ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oghene ko ji vwe ka obaro rere e vwo sivwi umuku re ihwo vwe akpo na rere ihwo re ovwan buebu vwo sa rho

quarantined_verses.text: O de siobọ nẹ emesẹ rọye yanran, rẹ ayen vwo kpo re, ọ da ta kẹ ayen, Wa ghwọ vwẹ idjerhe rẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o de siobo ne emese roye yanran re ayen vwo kpo re o da ta ke ayen wa ghwo vwe idjerhe re

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin ayen de vrẹn nẹ Ijipt, ayen de rhi te otọ ri Kenan re vwa Jekọp rẹ ọsẹ rayen.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen de vren ne ijipt ayen de rhi te oto ri kenan re vwa jekop re ose rayen

quarantined_verses.text: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọke rẹ ayen vwo gbe ikun ri Josẹf ejobi vwọ kẹ, eta rọ ta kẹ ayen, kugbe ọke rọ vwọ mrẹ akpẹrẹ ri Josẹf vwo rhe ne vwo muo rhe, udu ri Jekọp da rhe sasa;
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oke re ayen vwo gbe ikun ri josef ejobi vwo ke eta ro ta ke ayen kugbe oke ro vwo mre akpere ri josef vwo rhe ne vwo muo rhe udu ri jekop da rhe sasa

quarantined_verses.text: Izrẹl da ta, O teri; Josẹf rẹ ọmọ mẹ je akpọ, Me yanran re Me ra mrẹ tavwe mi ki ghwu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: izrel da ta o teri josef re omo me je akpo me yanran re me ra mre tavwe mi ki ghwu

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin ọ da ta, Mẹvwẹ Ọghẹnẹ, Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ wẹn, wọ djẹ oshọ ri wo vwo kpo Ijipt na-a, kidie Me dia oboyin ru we phihọ ẹgborho rode.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin o da ta mevwe oghene oghene re ose wen wo dje osho ri wo vwo kpo ijipt na a kidie me dia oboyin ru we phiho egborho rode

quarantined_verses.text: Me yan nene uwe kpo Ijipt na, Me je vwo we rhivwi rhe, abọ ri Josẹf ki rhurhu we ẹro.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: me yan nene uwe kpo ijipt na me je vwo we rhivwi rhe abo ri josef ki rhurhu we ero

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin Jekọp de vrẹn ni Bẹẹrsheba, emọ rẹ Izrẹl de mu Jekọp rẹ ọsẹ rayen, imitete rayen, kugbe eya rayen, phihọ ekpẹrẹ ri Fero vwọ rhe nẹ vwo muo rhe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop de vren ni beersheba emo re izrel de mu jekop re ose rayen imitete rayen kugbe eya rayen phiho ekpere ri fero vwo rhe ne vwo muo rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Ayen de ji mu uchuru rayen kugbe eyere rayen, re ayen vwori vwẹ otọ ri Kenan, ayen da rhe Ijipt, ti Jekọp vẹ uvwiẹ rọye ejobi,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ayen de ji mu uchuru rayen kugbe eyere rayen re ayen vwori vwe oto ri kenan ayen da rhe ijipt ti jekop ve uvwie roye ejobi

quarantined_verses.text: Enana keye edẹ rẹ uvwiẹ rẹ Izrẹl, re rhe otọ rẹ Ijipt, Jekọp vẹ emọ rọye. Rubẹn rẹ ọwanra,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: enana keye ede re uvwie re izrel re rhe oto re ijipt jekop ve emo roye ruben re owanra

quarantined_verses.text: O de ji Juda ka obaro bru Josẹf, rere o re dje idjerhe ri Goshẹn ke ayen, ayen de rhi te otọ ri Goshẹn.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o de ji juda ka obaro bru josef rere o re dje idjerhe ri goshen ke ayen ayen de rhi te oto ri goshen

quarantined_verses.text: O da reyọ eshare iyori vwẹ usun re emesẹ rọye ọ da vwẹ ayen nẹ Fero
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da reyo eshare iyori vwe usun re emese roye o da vwe ayen ne fero

quarantined_verses.text: Otọ rẹ Ijipt na ejobi obọ wẹn ọ epha; jẹn ọsẹ wẹn vẹ emesẹ wẹn dia asan ro Me yovwi vwẹ otọ na; jẹn ayen dia otọ ri Goshẹn, wọ da rha mrẹ ohwo rọ ganre vwẹ usun rayen, gbe jọ vwẹ ẹro te eranvwe mẹ.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oto re ijipt na ejobi obo wen o epha jen ose wen ve emese wen dia asan ro me yovwi vwe oto na jen ayen dia oto ri goshen wo da rha mre ohwo ro ganre vwe usun rayen gbe jo vwe ero te eranvwe me

quarantined_verses.text: Jekọp da nẹ ẹrhovwo ki Fero, ọ da yan nẹ obaro ri Fero.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jekop da ne erhovwo ki fero o da yan ne obaro ri fero

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ igho rẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt kugbe otọ ri Kenan vwo re nu, ihwo rẹ Ijipt ejobi de bru Josẹf rhe, ayen da ta, Kẹ avwanre emu, die avwanre di vwo ghwu vwẹ irharo wẹn? Kidie igho rẹ avwanre reri.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re igho re oto re ijipt kugbe oto ri kenan vwo re nu ihwo re ijipt ejobi de bru josef rhe ayen da ta ke avwanre emu die avwanre di vwo ghwu vwe irharo wen kidie igho re avwanre reri

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ ukpe yena vwo re nu, ayen de bro rhe vwẹ ukpe ro kpaherọ, ayen da ta kẹ, Avwanre sa djahe orovwovwe-e nẹ igho rẹ avwanre ejobi reri; uchuru rẹ avwanre ejobi ke e rẹ ọrovwovwe vwẹ etinẹ na; emu ọvuọvo gbi chekọ kẹ avwanre-e ọrovwovwe jokpa rẹ ugboma ofefe rẹ avwanre kugbe otọ rẹ avwanre.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re ukpe yena vwo re nu ayen de bro rhe vwe ukpe ro kpahero ayen da ta ke avwanre sa djahe orovwovwe e ne igho re avwanre ejobi reri uchuru re avwanre ejobi ke e re orovwovwe vwe etine na emu ovuovo gbi cheko ke avwanre e orovwovwe jokpa re ugboma ofefe re avwanre kugbe oto re avwanre

quarantined_verses.text: Die sorọ rẹ avwanre di vwo ghwu vwẹ irharo wẹn, te avwanre te etọ rẹ avwanre? Dẹ avwanre kugbe etọ rẹ avwanre vwẹ ọ rẹ emuọre, te avwanre te etọ rẹ avwanre ke dia eviẹn ri Fero; kẹ avwanre emamọ, re avwanre rhọ, ru Me je ghwo, rere otọ na vwo je fue.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: die soro re avwanre di vwo ghwu vwe irharo wen te avwanre te eto re avwanre de avwanre kugbe eto re avwanre vwe o re emuore te avwanre te eto re avwanre ke dia evien ri fero ke avwanre emamo re avwanre rho ru me je ghwo rere oto na vwo je fue

quarantined_verses.text: Kẹ enẹ Izrẹl rhe vwọ dia otọ rẹ Ijipt, vwẹ otọ ri Goshẹn, ayen de vwo ẹkẹn vwẹ evun rọye, ayen de vwiẹ buebu gangan.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ke ene izrel rhe vwo dia oto re ijipt vwe oto ri goshen ayen de vwo eken vwe evun roye ayen de vwie buebu gangan

quarantined_verses.text: Rẹ ọke rẹ ughwu rẹ Izrẹl vwọ kẹrẹ otọ re, o de se ọmọ rọye Josẹf ọ da ta kẹ, Ọ da dianẹ ivun mẹ ghene vwerhe owẹ, gbe phi obọ wẹn phihọ otọ rẹ ekpoghowọ mẹ, ru wo vẹ nẹ wo nene uvwe yeri eyere rẹ ọghọ vẹ uyota. Wo shi vwe phihọ Ijipt rẹ,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: re oke re ughwu re izrel vwo kere oto re o de se omo roye josef o da ta ke o da diane ivun me ghene vwerhe owe gbe phi obo wen phiho oto re ekpoghowo me ru wo ve ne wo nene uvwe yeri eyere re ogho ve uyota wo shi vwe phiho ijipt re

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ da ta, Duvwu iyori kẹ vwẹ, o de ghine duvwu iyori kẹ. Etiyin Izrẹl de gbe uyovwi kpotọ vwẹ enu rẹ ehwa rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o da ta duvwu iyori ke vwe o de ghine duvwu iyori ke etiyin izrel de gbe uyovwi kpoto vwe enu re ehwa roye

quarantined_verses.text: Jekọp da ta ki Josẹf, Ọghẹnẹ ro vwo Ẹgba vwẹ oma phia kẹ vwẹ vwi Luz vwẹ otọ ri Kenan o da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ vwẹ,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: jekop da ta ki josef oghene ro vwo egba vwe oma phia ke vwe vwi luz vwe oto ri kenan o da ne erhovwo ke vwe

quarantined_verses.text: Emọ rẹ ayen che vwiẹ ejobi ke dia ewẹn; ka vwẹ odẹ rẹ emesẹ rayen vwo se ayen vwẹ ẹdia rẹ uku rayen.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: emo re ayen che vwie ejobi ke dia ewen ka vwe ode re emese rayen vwo se ayen vwe edia re uku rayen

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke ri Josẹf vwọ mrẹ ọsẹ rọye rọ ghwẹ obọrhe rọye kpahe uyovwi rẹ Ifrem, o rhe je-e, ọ da kpare obọ rẹ ọsẹ rọye, nẹ uyovwi rẹ Ifrem re phihọ ọ ri Manasse.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke ri josef vwo mre ose roye ro ghwe oborhe roye kpahe uyovwi re ifrem o rhe je e o da kpare obo re ose roye ne uyovwi re ifrem re phiho o ri manasse

quarantined_verses.text: Ọ rọ ma rho ejobi Me vwọ kẹ wẹ ọ dia emesẹ wẹ-ẹn, ọghwrọrọ ọvo re Me vwẹ ọlọkọ vẹ umurhabọ mẹ vwọ reyọ mie ihwo rẹ Amọr.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: o ro ma rho ejobi me vwo ke we o dia emese we en oghwroro ovo re me vwe oloko ve umurhabo me vwo reyo mie ihwo re amor

quarantined_verses.text: Emu rẹ ọdafe ọye Asher cha re, emu rọ vwerhere rẹ ovie na ọye rhere.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: emu re odafe oye asher cha re emu ro vwerhere re ovie na oye rhere

quarantined_verses.text: Josẹf abọ rẹ urhe rọ riẹmọ, abọ re urhe rọ riẹmọ vwẹ orhoma rẹ urhie, abọ rọye de gro vrẹn enu rẹ ogba.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: josef abo re urhe ro riemo abo re urhe ro riemo vwe orhoma re urhie abo roye de gro vren enu re ogba

quarantined_verses.text: dede na umurhabọ rọye yegherii, Etiyin abọ rọye ke tua vwẹ obọ rẹ Ogangan ọvuọvo ri Jekọp (vwẹ odẹ rẹ Osuigodẹ, Orhaga rẹ Izrẹl).
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: dede na umurhabo roye yegherii etiyin abo roye ke tua vwe obo re ogangan ovuovo ri jekop vwe ode re osuigode orhaga re izrel

quarantined_verses.text: vwẹ obọ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ wẹn rọ cha wẹ uko, vwẹ obo rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ro vwo Ẹgba ko bruphihọ kẹ wẹ rọ kẹ wẹ ebruphihọ rẹ odjuvwu, ebruphihọ rẹ urhie rọ nọhọ otọ, ebruphihọ re evie kugbe eyenre.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwe obo re oghene re ose wen ro cha we uko vwe obo re oghene ro vwo egba ko bruphiho ke we ro ke we ebruphiho re odjuvwu ebruphiho re urhie ro noho oto ebruphiho re evie kugbe eyenre

quarantined_verses.text: Ebruphihọ rẹ ọsẹ wẹn i vwo ẹgba no ebruphihọ rẹ igbenu ri bẹdẹ na, oburhubu rẹ igbenu ri bẹdẹ, e dia uyovwi ri Josẹf, o dia arhare rẹ ohwo ra hẹriẹre nẹ oma rẹ emesẹ rọye.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ebruphiho re ose wen i vwo egba no ebruphiho re igbenu ri bede na oburhubu re igbenu ri bede e dia uyovwi ri josef o dia arhare re ohwo ra heriere ne oma re emese roye

quarantined_verses.text: Ọsẹ mẹ tanẹ, Mi duvwu iyori, tanẹ, Mi ghwẹ reọ; vwẹ evun rẹ ushi mẹ re Me tọn kẹ oma mẹ vwẹ otọ ri Kenan, Etiyin e shi vwe phihọ. Asakiephana gbe ju vwe ra, Me rẹ wẹ, re mi re shi ọsẹ mẹ, re mi rhivwi rhe.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ose me tane mi duvwu iyori tane mi ghwe reo vwe evun re ushi me re me ton ke oma me vwe oto ri kenan etiyin e shi vwe phiho asakiephana gbe ju vwe ra me re we re mi re shi ose me re mi rhivwi rhe

quarantined_verses.text: Ọke rẹ ihwo rẹ otọ na, ihwo ri Kenan vwọ mrẹ omaemuohọ vwẹ uwevwi rẹ ewunye rẹ Atad, ayen da ta, Ọnana okpemu rode ri ru ihwo rẹ Ijipt na. Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e vwo se asan na Abel-mizraim, ọ abọ oboyi ri Jọdan.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: oke re ihwo re oto na ihwo ri kenan vwo mre omaemuoho vwe uwevwi re ewunye re atad ayen da ta onana okpemu rode ri ru ihwo re ijipt na fiki re otioye na e vwo se asan na abel mizraim o abo oboyi ri jodan

quarantined_verses.text: Enẹ emọ rọye ru kẹ kirobo ro ji urhi kẹ ayen na,
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ene emo roye ru ke kirobo ro ji urhi ke ayen na

quarantined_verses.text: Etiyin ayen da vuẹ ovuẹ rhe Josẹf, tanẹ, Ọsẹ wẹn ji urhi nana ro ki ghwu.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da vue ovue rhe josef tane ose wen ji urhi nana ro ki ghwu

quarantined_verses.text: Ta ki Josẹf, Vwo ghovwo, Me rẹ we, ogbeku rẹ emesẹ wẹn kugbe umwemwu rayen kidie ayen ru imwemwu kpahe owẹ. Asakiephana, avwanre rẹ wẹ, vwo ghovwo ogbeku rẹ idibo rẹ Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ wẹn. Josẹf da viẹ rẹ ayen vwọ vuẹ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: ta ki josef vwo ghovwo me re we ogbeku re emese wen kugbe umwemwu rayen kidie ayen ru imwemwu kpahe owe asakiephana avwanre re we vwo ghovwo ogbeku re idibo re oghene re ose wen josef da vie re ayen vwo vue na

quarantined_verses.text: Vwọ kẹ ovwan, umwemwu we ru kpahe ovwẹ, ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ da rhẹriẹ umwemwu na vwọ erhuvwu kẹ vwẹ, o ruro rhe rere ihwo buebu vwọ rhọ, kirobo rọ epha nonẹ na.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: vwo ke ovwan umwemwu we ru kpahe ovwe ekevuovo oghene da rherie umwemwu na vwo erhuvwu ke vwe o ruro rhe rere ihwo buebu vwo rho kirobo ro epha none na

quarantined_verses.text: Ọtiọye na wa dje oshọ-ọ, Me je ghere ovwan vẹ emọ re ovwan. Kẹnẹ o phi udu phihọ ayen awọ o de bru ayen uche.
quarantined_verses.text_romanized: otioye na wa dje osho o me je ghere ovwan ve emo re ovwan kene o phi udu phiho ayen awo o de bru ayen uche
